text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who performs Hajj on behalf of others, would that suffice him from the Hajj of Al-Islam?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘Is the Hajj of the camelier complete or deficient?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Complete’. I said, ‘Is the Hajj of the hired one complete or deficient?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Complete’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ حَجَّ عَنْ غَيْرِهِ أَ يُجْزِئُهُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ حَجَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ حَجَّةُ الْجَمَّالِ تَامَّةٌ أَوْ نَاقِصَةٌ قَالَ تَامَّةٌ قُلْتُ حَجَّةُ الْأَجِيرِ تَامَّةٌ أَمْ نَاقِصَةٌ قَالَ تَامَّةٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who performs Hajj on behalf of others, would that suffice him from the Hajj of Al-Islam?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘Is the Hajj of the camelier complete or deficient?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Complete’. I said, ‘Is the Hajj of the hired one complete or deficient?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Complete’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/160)

text: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Abdullahasws asking himasws about a man who performed Hajj and neither knew nor recognised this matter (Al-Wilayah). Then Allahazwj Favoured upon him with his understanding and the Religion with it, is the Hajj of Al-Islam upon him (to perform again), or has it been fulfilled?’ Heasws said: ‘He has fulfilled an Obligation of Allahazwj, and the (repeating of the) Hajj is more beloved to measws’. And about a man who is among one of these types from the people of the Qiblah, a devout Nasibi. Then Allahazwj Favours upon him, so he recognises this matter (Al-Wilayah). Has the Hajj of Al-Islam been fulfilled from him, or it is (still) upon him that he should perform Hajj the coming year?’ Heasws said: ‘The (performance of the) Hajj is more beloved to measws’.

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ حَجَّ وَ لَا يَدْرِي وَ لَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ ثُمَّ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِمَعْرِفَتِهِ وَ الدَّيْنُونَةِ بِهِ أَ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ أَمْ قَدْ قَضَى قَالَ قَدْ قَضَى فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ وَ الْحَجُّ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ وَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ هُوَ فِي بَعْضِ هَذِهِ الْأَصْنَافِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ نَاصِبٍ مُتَدَيِّنٍ ثُمَّ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ أَ يُقْضَى عَنْهُ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ أَوْ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَحُجَّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ قَالَ الْحَجُّ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Mahziyar who said, ‘Ibrahim Bin Muhammad Bin Imran Al-Hamdany wrote to Abu Ja’farasws, ‘I performed Hajj, and I am an adversary, and I was Saroura (not having had performed Hajj before). So I included the Tamatto of Umra to the Hajj’. So heasws wrote to him: ‘Repeat your Hajj’.

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ الْهَمَدَانِيُّ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَنِّي حَجَجْتُ وَ أَنَا مُخَالِفٌ وَ كُنْتُ صَرُورَةً فَدَخَلْتُ مُتَمَتِّعاً بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ قَالَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ أَعِدْ حَجَّكَ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man is just passing through intending (to go to) Al-Yemen, or somewhere else from the cities, and on his way is Makkah. So he comes across the people who are going out to the Hajj. So he goes out with them to the memorial places. Would that suffice him from the Hajj of Al-Islam?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) الرَّجُلُ يَمُرُّ مُجْتَازاً يُرِيدُ الْيَمَنَ أَوْ غَيْرَهَا مِنَ الْبُلْدَانِ وَ طَرِيقُهُ بِمَكَّةَ فَيُدْرِكُ النَّاسَ وَ هُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ إِلَى الْحَجِّ فَيَخْرُجُ مَعَهُمْ إِلَى الْمَشَاهِدِ أَ يُجْزِئُهُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ حَجَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ نَعَمْ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man goes out to Makkah regarding business, or there happens to be a camel for him which he has hired. Would his Hajj be deficient or complete?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, but his Hajj is complete’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) الرَّجُلُ يَخْرُجُ فِي تِجَارَةٍ إِلَى مَكَّةَ أَوْ يَكُونُ لَهُ إِبِلٌ فَيُكْرِيهَا حَجَّتُهُ نَاقِصَةٌ أَمْ تَامَّةٌ قَالَ لَا بَلْ حَجَّتُهُ تَامَّةٌ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Shihab, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who freed a slave of his on the eve of Arafat. Would a Hajj be sufficed from the slave, a Hajj of Al-Islam?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘So if a mother of a child is taken to Hajj by her master, would it suffice from her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’. I said, ‘Is there any Recompense for him regarding her Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a boy of ten years performing Hajj’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon him is the Hajj of Al-Islam when he attains puberty, and similar to that is the girl, upon her would be the Hajj when she (starts) menstruating’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ عَشِيَّةَ عَرَفَةَ عَبْداً لَهُ أَ يُجْزِئُ عَنِ الْعَبْدِ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ فَأُمُّ وَلَدٍ أَحَجَّهَا مَوْلَاهَا أَ يُجْزِئُ عَنْهَا قَالَ لَا قُلْتُ أَ لَهُ أَجْرٌ فِي حَجَّتِهَا قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَشْرِ سِنِينَ يَحُجُّ قَالَ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ إِذَا احْتَلَمَ وَ كَذَلِكَ الْجَارِيَةُ عَلَيْهَا الْحَجُّ إِذَا طَمِثَتْ .

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon him is the Hajj of Al-Islam when he attains puberty, and similar to that is the girl, upon her would be the Hajj when she (starts) menstruating’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws the 2nd about the child, when can he wear Ihraam (Perform Hajj)?’ Heasws said: ‘When he can safeguard’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِيَ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الصَّبِيِّ مَتَى يُحْرَمُ بِهِ قَالَ إِذَا اثَّغَرَ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Zureys, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said regarding a man who went out as a Pilgrim for Hajj of Al-Islam, so he died on the way, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he died in ‘Al-Haram’ (the Sanctuary), the Hajj of Al-Islam would suffice from him, but if he had died besides the Sanctuary, so let it his guardian fulfil it on his behalf, the Hajj of Al-Islam’.

citation.arabic_text: فِي رَجُلٍ خَرَجَ حَاجّاً حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ فَمَاتَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ فَقَالَ إِنْ مَاتَ فِي الْحَرَمِ فَقَدْ أَجْزَأَتْ عَنْهُ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَاتَ دُونَ الْحَرَمِ فَلْيَقْضِ عَنْهُ وَلِيُّهُ حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Zureys, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said regarding a man who went out as a Pilgrim for Hajj of Al-Islam, so he died on the way, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he died in ‘Al-Haram’ (the Sanctuary), the Hajj of Al-Islam would suffice from him, but if he had died besides the Sanctuary, so let it his guardian fulfil it on his behalf, the Hajj of Al-Islam’.

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Bureyd Al Ijaly who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about a man who went out as a pilgrim and with him was a camel of his, and expense money, and provisions. So he died on the way’. Heasws said: ‘If he was Saroura (not having had performed Hajj), then died in Ihraam, so it has sufficed from him for Hajj of Al-Islam; but if he died and he was Saroura (not having had performed Hajj) before he wore Ihraam, his camel and his provisions and his expenses would be made to be for a Hajj of Al-Islam. So if there is something excess from that, so it would be for the inheritors, if there do no happen to be debts upon him’. I said, ‘What is yourasws view if the Hajj was optional, then he died on the way before he wore Ihraam, for whom would be his camel, and his expense money, and whatever was with him?’ Heasws said: ‘Whatever was with him, and whatever he left would happen to be for his inheritors, except if there happen to be debts upon him, so these would be fulfilled on his behalf; or if he had bequeathed with a bequest, so that bequest would be established for the one to whom it had been bequeathed to, and that would be made to be from his one-third (of his wealth/belongings)’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ خَرَجَ حَاجّاً وَ مَعَهُ جَمَلٌ لَهُ وَ نَفَقَةٌ وَ زَادٌ فَمَاتَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ قَالَ إِنْ كَانَ صَرُورَةً ثُمَّ مَاتَ فِي الْحَرَمِ فَقَدْ أَجْزَأَ عَنْهُ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَاتَ وَ هُوَ صَرُورَةٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ جُعِلَ جَمَلُهُ وَ زَادُهُ وَ نَفَقَتُهُ وَ مَا مَعَهُ فِي حَجَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِ فَإِنْ فَضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْ‏ءٌ فَهُوَ لِلْوَرَثَةِ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ قُلْتُ أَ رَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَتِ الْحَجَّةُ تَطَوُّعاً ثُمَّ مَاتَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ لِمَنْ يَكُونُ جَمَلُهُ وَ نَفَقَتُهُ وَ مَا مَعَهُ قَالَ يَكُونُ جَمِيعُ مَا مَعَهُ وَ مَا تَرَكَ لِلْوَرَثَةِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ فَيُقْضَى عَنْهُ أَوْ يَكُونَ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةٍ فَيُنْفَذَ ذَلِكَ لِمَنْ أَوْصَى لَهُ وَ يُجْعَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ ثُلُثِهِ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Bureyd Al Ijaly who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about a man who went out as a pilgrim and with him was a camel of his, and expense money, and provisions. So he died on the way’. Heasws said: ‘If he was Saroura (not having had performed Hajj), then died in Ihraam, so it has sufficed from him for Hajj of Al-Islam; but if he died and he was Saroura (not having had performed Hajj) before he wore Ihraam, his camel and his provisions and his expenses would be made to be for a Hajj of Al-Islam. text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Rafa’at who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who vowed that he would walk to the Sacred House of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, would that suffice from the Hajj of Al-Islam?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘And if he performs Hajj on behalf of others and there does not happen to be wealth for him, and he had vowed that he would be performing Hajj walking, would that suffice from him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ إِلَى بَيْتِ اللَّهِ الْحَرَامِ أَ يُجْزِئُهُ ذَلِكَ عَنْ حَجَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ وَ إِنْ حَجَّ عَنْ غَيْرِهِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ وَ قَدْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَحُجَّ مَاشِياً أَ يُجْزِئُ ذَلِكَ عَنْهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ .

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Aamir Bin Ameyra who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘It has reached me from you<sup>asws</sup> that you<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘If a man dies and had not performed Hajj, a Hajj of Al-Islam, so one of his family members performs Hajj on his behalf, that would suffice from him’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. I<sup>asws</sup> have it (the Hadeeth) from my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>. He<sup>asws</sup> narrated to me<sup>asws</sup> that a man came over to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, so he said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! My father died and did not perform Hajj’. text: From him, from Safwan, from Hakam Bin Hukeym who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘A person died and had not performed Hajj and did not bequeath with the Hajj to be performed. So one of his family members, a man or a woman performs Hajj on his behalf. Would that suffice him, and become a payback (Qazaa) from it, and the Hajj would happen to be for the one who performed Hajj and paid for the one to perform the Hajj on his behalf?’ So heasws said: ‘If the pilgrim was not Saroura (not having had performed Hajj), it would suffice from both of them together, and the Recompense would be for the one who performed his Hajj’.

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat, from Rafa’at who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who dies and did not perform Hajj, a Hajj of Al-Islam, and did not bequeath with it, does it have to be fulfilled on his behalf?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.

citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat, from Rafa’at who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who dies and did not perform Hajj, a Hajj of Al-Islam, and did not bequeath with it, does it have to be fulfilled on his behalf?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Rafa’at who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man and the woman both dying and had not performed Hajj, does it have to be fulfilled from both of them, a Hajj of Al-Islam?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ وَ الْمَرْأَةِ يَمُوتَانِ وَ لَمْ يَحُجَّا أَ يُقْضَى عَنْهُمَا حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ نَعَمْ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Rafa’at who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man and the woman both dying and had not performed Hajj, does it have to be fulfilled from both of them, a Hajj of Al-Islam?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/166)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a man who died and for him was a son who did not know whether his father had performed Hajj or not’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should perform Hajj on his behalf. So if it was such that his father had performed Hajj, an optional (Hajj) would be Written for his father, and for the son, the Obligatory (Hajj); and if it was such that his father had not performed Hajj, an Obligatory (Hajj) would be Written for his father, and for the son, the optional (Hajj)’.

citation.arabic_text: سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ لَهُ ابْنٌ لَمْ يَدْرِ أَ حَجَّ أَبُوهُ أَمْ لَا قَالَ يَحُجُّ عَنْهُ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَبُوهُ قَدْ حَجَّ كُتِبَ لِأَبِيهِ نَافِلَةً وَ لِلِابْنِ فَرِيضَةً وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَبُوهُ لَمْ يَحُجَّ كُتِبَ لِأَبِيهِ فَرِيضَةً وَ لِلِابْنِ نَافِلَةً .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a man who died and for him was a son who did not know whether his father had performed Hajj or not’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should perform Hajj on his behalf. So if it was such that his father had performed Hajj, an optional (Hajj) would be Written for his father, and for the son, the Obligatory (Hajj); and if it was such that his father had not performed Hajj, an Obligatory (Hajj) would be Written for his father, and for the son, the optional (Hajj)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/166)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman Al Asamma, from Misma’a Bin Abdul Malik, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘If a servant performs Hajj ten times, there would (still) be upon him a Hajj of Al-Islam as well, when he has the capacity to that. And if a young boy were to perform Hajj ten times, then attains puberty, upon him would be an Obligation of Al-Islam, and if an owned slave performs Hajj ten times, then is freed, upon him would be an Obligation of Al-Islam, when he has the capacity for it’.

citation.arabic_text: لَوْ أَنَّ عَبْداً حَجَّ عَشْرَ حِجَجٍ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ أَيْضاً إِذَا اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَى ذَلِكَ سَبِيلًا وَ لَوْ أَنَّ غُلَاماً حَجَّ عَشْرَ حِجَجٍ ثُمَّ احْتَلَمَ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَرِيضَةُ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ لَوْ أَنَّ مَمْلُوكاً حَجَّ عَشْرَ حِجَجٍ ثُمَّ أُعْتِقَ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَرِيضَةُ الْإِسْلَامِ إِذَا اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman Al Asamma, from Misma’a Bin Abdul Malik, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘If a servant performs Hajj ten times, there would (still) be upon him a Hajj of Al-Islam as well, when he has the capacity to that. And if a young boy were to perform Hajj ten times, then attains puberty, upon him would be an Obligation of Al-Islam, and if an owned slave performs Hajj ten times, then is freed, upon him would be an Obligation of Al-Islam, when he has the capacity for it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/167)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Nahdy, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Aban, from Zareeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one for whom five years pass by, so he does not become a delegate to his Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, and he was affluent, he is a deprived one’.

citation.arabic_text: مَنْ مَضَتْ لَهُ خَمْسُ سِنِينَ فَلَمْ يَفِدْ إِلَى رَبِّهِ وَ هُوَ مُوسِرٌ إِنَّهُ لَمَحْرُومٌ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Nahdy, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Aban, from Zareeh, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one for whom five years pass by, so he does not become a delegate to his Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, and he was affluent, he is a deprived one’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/167)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ibrahim Bin Is’haq, from Abdullah Bin Hammad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Humran, from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘For Allah<sup>azwj</sup> there is a Caller who calls out: ‘Whichever servant upon whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Favoured, and Expanded upon him in his sustenance, so he does not delegate to Him<sup>azwj</sup> during every five years in order to seek His<sup>azwj</sup> Additional (Favours), that is a deprived one’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي أَيُّ عَبْدٍ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ وَ أَوْسَعَ عَلَيْهِ فِي رِزْقِهِ فَلَمْ يَفِدْ إِلَيْهِ فِي كُلِّ خَمْسَةِ أَعْوَامٍ مَرَّةً لِيَطْلُبَ نَوَافِلَهُ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَمَحْرُومٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ibrahim Bin Is’haq, from Abdullah Bin Hammad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Humran, from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘For Allah<sup>azwj</sup> there is a Caller who calls out: ‘Whichever servant upon whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Favoured, and Expanded upon him in his sustenance, so he does not delegate to Him<sup>azwj</sup> during every five years in order to seek His<sup>azwj</sup> Additional (Favours), that is a deprived one’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/167)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abu Talib, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who performs Hajj by incurring debt, and he had performed a Hajj, of Hajj of Al-Islam’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be Causing it to be paid off from him, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَحُجُّ بِدَيْنٍ وَ قَدْ حَجَّ حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ نَعَمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيَقْضِي عَنْهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Abu Talib, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who performs Hajj by incurring debt, and he had performed a Hajj, of Hajj of Al-Islam’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be Causing it to be paid off from him, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/168)

text: Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Musa Bin Bakr, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Can the man borrow and perform Hajj when there was a replacement asset behind him what could pay it off on his behalf, when the event of death occurs with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لَهُ هَلْ يَسْتَقْرِضُ الرَّجُلُ وَ يَحُجُّ إِذَا كَانَ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ مَا يُؤَدَّى عَنْهُ إِذَا حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ قَالَ نَعَمْ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Musa Bin Bakr, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Can the man borrow and perform Hajj when there was a replacement asset behind him what could pay it off on his behalf, when the event of death occurs with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/168)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abdul Malik Bin Utba who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the man upon whom are debts; can he borrow and perform Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If there was for him a (replacement) asset in wealth, so there is no problem’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ يَسْتَقْرِضُ وَ يَحُجُّ قَالَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ وَجْهٌ فِي مَالٍ فَلَا بَأْسَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abdul Malik Bin Utba who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the man upon whom are debts; can he borrow and perform Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If there was for him a (replacement) asset in wealth, so there is no problem’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/168)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Hammam who said, ‘I said to Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man happens to have the debt upon him, and something present itself to him, should he pay off his debt or perform Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should pay off part of it and perform Hajj with part of it’. I said, ‘Supposing it does not happen to be except a quantity for expenditure of the Hajj?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should pay off one year, and he should perform Hajj one year’. So I said, ‘(Supposing if) the wealth is given from the Sultan (ruling authority)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem upon you’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) الرَّجُلُ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ الدَّيْنُ وَ يَحْضُرُهُ الشَّيْ‏ءُ أَ يَقْضِي دَيْنَهُ أَوْ يَحُجُّ قَالَ يَقْضِي بِبَعْضٍ وَ يَحُجُّ بِبَعْضٍ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَكُونُ إِلَّا بِقَدْرِ نَفَقَةِ الْحَجِّ فَقَالَ يَقْضِي سَنَةً وَ يَحُجُّ سَنَةً فَقُلْتُ أُعْطِيَ الْمَالَ مِنْ نَاحِيَةِ السُّلْطَانِ قَالَ لَا بَأْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Hammam who said, ‘I said to Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man happens to have the debt upon him, and something present itself to him, should he pay off his debt or perform Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should pay off part of it and perform Hajj with part of it’. I said, ‘Supposing it does not happen to be except a quantity for expenditure of the Hajj?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should pay off one year, and he should perform Hajj one year’. So I said, ‘(Supposing if) the wealth is given from the Sultan (ruling authority)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem upon you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/168)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, from someone else who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘There happen to be debts upon me, and the Dirhams occur upon my hands. So, if I were to distribute these between them, there would not remain anything. Shall I perform Hajj with it or distribute these between the creditors?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You should perform Hajj with it and supplicate to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> should Cause the fulfilment of your debts from you’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَكُونُ عَلَيَّ الدَّيْنُ فَيَقَعُ فِي يَدِيَ الدَّرَاهِمُ فَإِنْ وَزَّعْتُهَا بَيْنَهُمْ لَمْ يَبْقَ شَيْ‏ءٌ أَ فَأَحُجُّ بِهَا أَوْ أُوَزِّعُهَا بَيْنَ الْغُرَّامِ فَقَالَ تَحُجُّ بِهَا وَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ عَنْكَ دَيْنَكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, from someone else who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘There happen to be debts upon me, and the Dirhams occur upon my hands. citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل كالحسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/169)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Barqy, from Ja’far Bin Basheer, from Musa Bin Bakr Al Wasity who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the man who borrows and performs Hajj, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he has wealth left behind, if the event of death were to occur with him, so it would be paid off from him, so there is no problem’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَقْرِضُ وَ يَحُجُّ فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ مَالٌ إِنْ حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ أُدِّيَ عَنْهُ فَلَا بَأْسَ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Barqy, from Ja’far Bin Basheer, from Musa Bin Bakr Al Wasity who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the man who borrows and performs Hajj, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he has wealth left behind, if the event of death were to occur with him, so it would be paid off from him, so there is no problem’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/169)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘If one of you were to make a profit, should take something from it and isolate it, and he should say, ‘This is for the Hajj’. And when he makes a profit and takes from it and says, ‘This is for the Hajj’, and the time for the Hajj comes, it would have gathered for him the (required) expenditure, he would be determined for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and would go out. But if one of you makes the profit and he spends it, and the time for the Hajj comes, and he intends to go, he would be taking that from the capital of his wealth, thus it would be difficult upon him’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا رَبِحَ الرِّبْحَ أَخَذَ مِنْهُ الشَّيْ‏ءَ فَعَزَلَهُ فَقَالَ هَذَا لِلْحَجِّ وَ إِذَا رَبِحَ أَخَذَ مِنْهُ وَ قَالَ هَذَا لِلْحَجِّ جَاءَ إِبَّانُ الْحَجِّ وَ قَدِ اجْتَمَعَتْ لَهُ نَفَقَةٌ عَزَمَ اللَّهَ فَخَرَجَ وَ لَكِنْ أَحَدُكُمْ يَرْبَحُ الرِّبْحَ فَيُنْفِقُهُ فَإِذَا جَاءَ إِبَّانُ الْحَجِّ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَأْسِ مَالِهِ فَيَشُقُّ عَلَيْهِ .

But if one of you makes the profit and he spends it, and the time for the Hajj comes, and he intends to go, he would be taking that from the capital of his wealth, thus it would be difficult upon him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/169)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Barqy, from a sheikh, (It has been narrated) raising the Hadeeth to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said to him: ‘O so and so! Reduce the expenditure regarding the Hajj, you would be vigorous for the Hajj, and do not spend abundantly regarding the Hajj, so you would be weary of it’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لَهُ يَا فُلَانُ أَقْلِلِ النَّفَقَةَ فِي الْحَجِّ تَنْشَطْ لِلْحَجِّ وَ لَا تُكْثِرِ النَّفَقَةَ فِي الْحَجِّ فَتَمَلَّ الْحَجَّ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Barqy, from a sheikh, (It has been narrated) raising the Hadeeth to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said to him: ‘O so and so! Reduce the expenditure regarding the Hajj, you would be vigorous for the Hajj, and do not spend abundantly regarding the Hajj, so you would be weary of it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرفوع - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/170)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Rabie Bin Abdullah who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> was, if his<sup>asws</sup> ride (stirrup) was cut off in the road to Makkah, he<sup>asws</sup> would tighten it especially to ease the Hajj upon himself<sup>asws</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ ( صلوات الله عليه ) لَيَنْقَطِعُ رِكَابُهُ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ فَيَشُدُّهُ بِخُوصَةٍ لِيُهَوِّنَ الْحَجَّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Rabie Bin Abdullah who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> was, if his<sup>asws</sup> ride (stirrup) was cut off in the road to Makkah, he<sup>asws</sup> would tighten it especially to ease the Hajj upon himself<sup>asws</sup>’.

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, (It has been narrated) raising it from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The sacrificial animal is from the expenditure of the Hajj’.

citation.arabic_text: الْهَدِيَّةُ مِنْ نَفَقَةِ الْحَجِّ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, (It has been narrated) raising it from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The sacrificial animal is from the expenditure of the Hajj’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/170)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A sacrificial animal of the Hajj is from the Hajj (expenditure)’.

citation.arabic_text: هَدِيَّةُ الْحَجِّ مِنَ الْحَجِّ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A sacrificial animal of the Hajj is from the Hajj (expenditure)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/170)

text: A number of our companins, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Za’lan, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Hammad Bin Talha, from Isa Bin Abu Mansour who said, ‘Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Isa! I<sup>asws</sup> would love it that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would See you, in what is between the Hajj to the Hajj, and you are prepared for the Hajj’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ لِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ ( عليه السلام ) يَا عِيسَى إِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ يَرَاكَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ إِلَى الْحَجِّ وَ أَنْتَ تَتَهَيَّأُ لِلْحَجِّ .
citation.translation: A number of our companins, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Za’lan, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Hammad Bin Talha, from Isa Bin Abu Mansour who said, ‘Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Isa! I<sup>asws</sup> would love it that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would See you, in what is between the Hajj to the Hajj, and you are prepared for the Hajj’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/171)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Bin Usman, and Muhammad Bin Abu Hama, and someone else, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who prepares the carriage for the Hajj is like the one who ties his horse in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَنِ اتَّخَذَ مَحْمِلًا لِلْحَجِّ كَانَ كَمَنْ رَبَطَ فَرَساً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Bin Usman, and Muhammad Bin Abu Hama, and someone else, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who prepares the carriage for the Hajj is like the one who ties his horse in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن أو موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/171)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Hamza Bin Ya’la, from one of the Kufi’s, from Ahmad Bin Aiz, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who returns from Makkah, and he is intending the Hajj from the coming year, would have an increase in his life-span’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ مَنْ رَجَعَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ وَ هُوَ يَنْوِي الْحَجَّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ زِيدَ فِي عُمُرِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Hamza Bin Ya’la, from one of the Kufi’s, from Ahmad Bin Aiz, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who returns from Makkah, and he is intending the Hajj from the coming year, would have an increase in his life-span’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/171)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibrahim Bin Maymoun, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man who became a Muslim, so he intended to perform Hajj, and the (season) for the Hajj had presented itself, should he perform Hajj or should he be circumcised?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should not perform Hajj until he is circumcised’.

citation.arabic_text: الرَّجُلِ يُسْلِمُ فَيُرِيدُ أَنْ يَحُجَّ وَ قَدْ حَضَرَ الْحَجُّ أَ يَحُجُّ أَوْ يَخْتَتِنُ قَالَ لَا يَحُجُّ حَتَّى يَخْتَتِنَ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibrahim Bin Maymoun, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man who became a Muslim, so he intended to perform Hajj, and the (season) for the Hajj had presented itself, should he perform Hajj or should he be circumcised?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should not perform Hajj until he is circumcised’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/171)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is no problem if the woman circumambulates without having been circumcised, but as for the man, so he should not circumambulate unless he is circumcised’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَطُوفَ الْمَرْأَةُ غَيْرَ الْمَخْفُوضَةِ فَأَمَّا الرَّجُلُ فَلَا يَطُوفُ إِلَّا وَ هُوَ مُخْتَتِنٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is no problem if the woman circumambulates without having been circumcised, but as for the man, so he should not circumambulate unless he is circumcised’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/172)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a woman who had a husband for her who refused to allow her that she should perform Hajj, and she had not performed the Hajj of Al-Islam. So the husband was absent from her, and he had forbidden her to perform Hajj. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no obedience to him upon her with regards to Hajj of Al-Islam, so let her perform Hajj if she so desires it’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ لَهَا زَوْجٌ أَبَى أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهَا أَنْ تَحُجَّ وَ لَمْ تَحُجَّ حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ فَغَابَ زَوْجُهَا عَنْهَا وَ قَدْ نَهَاهَا أَنْ تَحُجَّ قَالَ لَا طَاعَةَ لَهُ عَلَيْهَا فِي حَجَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِ فَلْتَحُجَّ إِنْ شَاءَتْ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a woman who had a husband for her who refused to allow her that she should perform Hajj, and she had not performed the Hajj of Al-Islam. So the husband was absent from her, and he had forbidden her to perform Hajj. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no obedience to him upon her with regards to Hajj of Al-Islam, so let her perform Hajj if she so desires it’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the woman who went out (for Hajj) with other than a guardian. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem. So if there was a husband for her, or a son of a brother being able upon them going out along with her, and there was no (financial) capacity for her, so it is not befitting for her that she should sit (not perform Hajj), nor is it befitting for them that they prevent her’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَخْرُجُ مَعَ غَيْرِ وَلِيٍّ قَالَ لَا بَأْسَ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهَا زَوْجٌ أَوِ ابْنُ أَخٍ قَادِرَيْنِ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْرُجَا مَعَهَا وَ لَيْسَ لَهَا سَعَةٌ فَلَا يَنْبَغِي لَهَا أَنْ تَقْعُدَ وَ لَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ أَنْ يَمْنَعُوهَا .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the woman who went out (for Hajj) with other than a guardian. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem. So if there was a husband for her, or a son of a brother being able upon them going out along with her, and there was no (financial) capacity for her, so it is not befitting for her that she should sit (not perform Hajj), nor is it befitting for them that they prevent her’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/172)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about a woman having a husband for her, and she is a Sarourat (not having had performed Hajj), who is not permitting to her for the Hajj’. Heasws said: ‘She should perform Hajj, and even if he has not permitted to her’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ لَهَا زَوْجٌ وَ هِيَ صَرُورَةٌ لَا يَأْذَنُ لَهَا فِي الْحَجِّ قَالَ تَحُجُّ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَهَا .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about a woman having a husband for her, and she is a Sarourat (not having had performed Hajj), who is not permitting to her for the Hajj’. Heasws said: ‘She should perform Hajj, and even if he has not permitted to her’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/173)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Suleyman Bin Khalid, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the woman intending the Hajj, not having a close relative for her, would it be correct for her to perform Hajj?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, when she was (with the) trustworthy (ones)’.

citation.arabic_text: الْمَرْأَةِ تُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا مَحْرَمٌ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهَا الْحَجُّ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ إِذَا كَانَتْ مَأْمُونَةً .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Suleyman Bin Khalid, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the woman intending the Hajj, not having a close relative for her, would it be correct for her to perform Hajj?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, when she was (with the) trustworthy (ones)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/173)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Muawiya who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the free woman going for Hajj to Makkah without a guardian, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with her going out with a reliable group’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( صلوات الله عليه ) عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحُرَّةِ تَحُجُّ إِلَى مَكَّةَ بِغَيْرِ وَلِيٍّ فَقَالَ لَا بَأْسَ تَخْرُجُ مَعَ قَوْمٍ ثِقَاتٍ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Muawiya who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the free woman going for Hajj to Makkah without a guardian, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with her going out with a reliable group’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/173)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘A mam will not leave behind upon his family with something superior than two Cycles (of Prayer) which he Prays when intending the going out to travel. He should be saying, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I entrust to You<sup>azwj</sup>, myself, and my family, and my wealth, and my offspring, and my world, and my Hereafter, and my entrustments, and the completion of my (pending) works’, except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Give him what he asks for’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَا اسْتَخْلَفَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ بِخِلَافَةٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَرْكَعُهُمَا إِذَا أَرَادَ الْخُرُوجَ إِلَى سَفَرٍ يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ نَفْسِي وَ أَهْلِي وَ مَالِي وَ ذُرِّيَّتِي وَ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي وَ أَمَانَتِي وَ خَاتِمَةَ عَمَلِي إِلَّا أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ مَا سَأَلَ.
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘A mam will not leave behind upon his family with something superior than two Cycles (of Prayer) which he Prays when intending the going out to travel. He should be saying, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I entrust to You<sup>azwj</sup>, myself, and my family, and my wealth, and my offspring, and my world, and my Hereafter, and my entrustments, and the completion of my (pending) works’, except that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Give him what he asks for’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/174)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Haris Bin Muhammad Al Ahowl, from Bureyd Bin Muawiya Al Ijaly who said, ‘It was such that whenever Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> intended the travel, would gather his<sup>asws</sup> dependents in a room, then say: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> entrust to You<sup>azwj</sup>, myself<sup>asws</sup>, and my<sup>asws</sup> wealth, and my<sup>asws</sup> family, and my<sup>asws</sup> children, the ones present from us and the absent. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Protect us and Protect upon us. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Make us to be in Your<sup>azwj</sup> vicinity. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Do not Confiscate Your<sup>azwj</sup> Bounties from us, and do not Change what is with us, from good health from You<sup>azwj</sup> and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grace’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) إِذَا أَرَادَ سَفَراً جَمَعَ عِيَالَهُ فِي بَيْتٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ الْغَدَاةَ نَفْسِي وَ مَالِي وَ أَهْلِي وَ وُلْدِي الشَّاهِدَ مِنَّا وَ الْغَائِبَ اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنَا وَ احْفَظْ عَلَيْنَا اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا فِي جِوَارِكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَسْلُبْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ وَ لَا تُغَيِّرْ مَا بِنَا مِنْ عَافِيَتِكَ وَ فَضْلِكَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Haris Bin Muhammad Al Ahowl, from Bureyd Bin Muawiya Al Ijaly who said, ‘It was such that whenever Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> intended the travel, would gather his<sup>asws</sup> dependents in a room, then say: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I<sup>asws</sup> entrust to You<sup>azwj</sup>, myself<sup>asws</sup>, and my<sup>asws</sup> wealth, and my<sup>asws</sup> family, and my<sup>asws</sup> children, the ones present from us and the absent. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Protect us and Protect upon us. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Make us to be in Your<sup>azwj</sup> vicinity. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Do not Confiscate Your<sup>azwj</sup> Bounties from us, and do not Change what is with us, from good health from You<sup>azwj</sup> and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grace’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/174)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Is the travelling abhorred regarding something from the disliked days, the Wednesday and others?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Begin your travel with the charity, and recite the Verse of the Chair (Chapter 2:255), when it begins for you’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَ يُكْرَهُ السَّفَرُ فِي شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنَ الْأَيَّامِ الْمَكْرُوهَةِ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ وَ غَيْرِهِ فَقَالَ افْتَتِحْ سَفَرَكَ بِالصَّدَقَةِ وَ اقْرَأْ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ إِذَا بَدَا لَكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Is the travelling abhorred regarding something from the disliked days, the Wednesday and others?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Begin your travel with the charity, and recite the Verse of the Chair (Chapter 2:255), when it begins for you’.

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub,from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjal who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Give charity and go out in whichever day you so desire to’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) تَصَدَّقْ وَ اخْرُجْ أَيَّ يَوْمٍ شِئْتَ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Musa Bin Al Qasim who said, ‘Sabah Al Haza’a narrated to us saying, ‘I heard Musa<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘If the man among you intends the travel, should stand upon the door of his house, turn his face to be towards the direction which he is diverting to, so he should recite the Opening of the Book (Chapter 1) in front of him, and on his right, and on his left, and the Verse of the Chair (Ch 2 V 255) in front of him, and on his right, and on his left. Then he should say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Protect me and Protect what is with me, and Secure me and Secure what is with me, and Make me reach (the destination) and Make what is with me to reach (its destination) with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Goodly Delivery’, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> will Protect him and Protect what is with him, and Secure him and Secure what is with him, and Deliver him (to the destination) and Deliver what is with him (to the destination)’. He (the narrator) said, ‘Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Sabah! Have you not seen them man who is Protected and what is with him is not protected, and he is safe but what is with him is not safe, and he reaches (the destination) and what is with him does not reach?’ I said, ‘Yes, may I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا صَبَّاحٌ الْحَذَّاءُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ لَوْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْكُمْ إِذَا أَرَادَ السَّفَرَ قَامَ عَلَى بَابِ دَارِهِ تِلْقَاءَ وَجْهِهِ الَّذِي يَتَوَجَّهُ لَهُ فَقَرَأَ فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ أَمَامَهُ وَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ وَ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ أَمَامَهُ وَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي وَ احْفَظْ مَا مَعِي وَ سَلِّمْنِي وَ سَلِّمْ مَا مَعِي وَ بَلِّغْنِي وَ بَلِّغْ مَا مَعِي بِبَلَاغِكَ الْحَسَنِ لَحَفِظَهُ اللَّهُ وَ حَفِظَ مَا مَعَهُ وَ سَلَّمَهُ وَ سَلَّمَ مَا مَعَهُ وَ بَلَّغَهُ وَ بَلَّغَ مَا مَعَهُ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا صَبَّاحُ أَ مَا رَأَيْتَ الرَّجُلَ يُحْفَظُ وَ لَا يُحْفَظُ مَا مَعَهُ وَ يَسْلَمُ وَ لَا يَسْلَمُ مَا مَعَهُ وَ يَبْلُغُ وَ لَا يَبْلُغُ مَا مَعَهُ قُلْتُ بَلَى جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Safwan Bin Yahya, altogether from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Whenever you go out from your house intending the Hajj and the Umra, Allahazwj Willing, so supplicate with the supplication of the Relief (Du’a Al-Faraj), and it is, ‘There is no god except for Allahazwj, the Lenient, the Benevolent. There is no god except for Allahazwj the Exalted, the Magnificent. Glory be to Allahazwj, Lordazwj of the seven skies, and Lordazwj of the seven firmaments, and Lordazwj of the Magnificent Throne. And the Praise is for Allahazwj, Lordazwj of the Worlds’. Then say, ‘O Allahazwj! Be a Protector of mine from every stubborn tyrant, and from every castaway Satanla’. Then say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj do I enter, and in the Name of Allahazwj do I go out, and in the Way of Allahazwj. O Allahazwj! I proceed in front of me with my forgetfulness and my haste. In the Name of Allahazwj and whatever Allahazwj so Desires, in this journey of mine, I shall remember it or forget it. O Allahazwj! Youazwj are the Aider upon the affairs, all of them, and Youazwj are the Companion in the journey, and the Caliph (Caretaker) regarding the family. O Allahazwj! Ease our journey upon us, and Fold the land for us, and Make us to travel in it in Yourazwj as well as in the obedience of Yourazwj Rasoolsaww. O Allahazwj! Correct our backs for us and Bless for us in what Yourazwj Grace upon us and Save us from the Punishment of the Fire. O Allahazwj! I seek Refuge with Youazwj from the fatigue of the travel, and anguish of the return, and the evil scenarios regarding the family, and the wealth, and the children. O Allahazwj! Youazwj are my Reinforcement and my Helper. It is with Youazwj that I disembark and with Youazwj that I travel. O Allahazwj! I ask you for the tranquillity in this journey of mine, and the actions with what Youazwj would be Pleased with from me. O Allahazwj! Cut-off the difficulties from me after it, and be my Companion in it, and my Caliph (Caretaker) regarding my family with goodness; and there is neither Might nor Strength except with Allahazwj. O Allahazwj! I am Yourazwj servant and this is Yourazwj Carrier, and the direction is Yourazwj Direction, and the journey is to Youazwj, and Youazwj are being notified upon what no one is notified upon. Therefore, Make this journey of mine to be an expiation for my sins which were before it, and Be a Supporter of mine upon it, and Suffice me from its fatigue, and its difficulties, and Attach me with Yourazwj Pleasure from the words and the deeds, for rather, I am Yourazwj servant, and with Youazwj, and for Youazwj’. So when you make your feet to be in the stirrups, so say, ‘In the Name of Allahazwj the Beneficent, the Merciful. In the Name of Allahazwj, and Allahazwj is the Greatest’. So when you are established upon your ride, and your carriage is (also) established with you, so say, ‘The Praise is for Allahazwj who Guided us to Al-Islam and Taught us the Quran, and Favoured upon us with Muhammadsaww. Glroy be to Allahazwj! [43:13] Glory be to Him Who Made this subservient to us and we were not able to do it [43:14] And surely to our Lord we must return, and the Praise is for Allahazwj, Lordazwj of the Worlds. O Allahazwj! Youazwj are the Carrier upon the backs, and the Supporter upon the affairs. O Allahazwj! Deliver us (to our destination) with an arrival, which reaches to a goodly arrival, reaching to Yourazwj Forgiveness, and Yourazwj Pleasure. O Allahazwj! There is no traversing except for Yourazwj Making us traverse, and there is no goodness except for Yourazwj Goodness, and there is no Protector apart from Youazwj’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا خَرَجْتَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ تُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ وَ الْعُمْرَةَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَادْعُ دُعَاءَ الْفَرَجِ وَ هُوَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبِّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ثُمَّ قُلْ اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ وَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ ثُمَّ قُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ دَخَلْتُ وَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْتُ وَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُقَدِّمُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نِسْيَانِي وَ عَجَلَتِي بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فِي سَفَرِي هَذَا ذَكَرْتُهُ أَوْ نَسِيتُهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا وَ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَ الْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا وَ اطْوِ لَنَا الْأَرْضَ وَ سَيِّرْنَا فِيهَا بِطَاعَتِكَ وَ طَاعَةِ رَسُولِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لَنَا ظَهْرَنَا وَ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَ كَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَ سُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَ الْمَالِ وَ الْوَلَدِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَ نَاصِرِي بِكَ أَحُلُّ وَ بِكَ أَسِيرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِي هَذَا السُّرُورَ وَ الْعَمَلَ بِمَا يُرْضِيكَ عَنِّي اللَّهُمَّ اقْطَعْ عَنِّي بُعْدَهُ وَ مَشَقَّتَهُ وَ اصْحَبْنِي فِيهِ وَ اخْلُفْنِي فِي أَهْلِي بِخَيْرٍ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ وَ هَذَا حُمْلَانُكَ وَ الْوَجْهُ وَجْهُكَ وَ السَّفَرُ إِلَيْكَ وَ قَدِ اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَى مَا لَمْ يَطَّلِعْ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ فَاجْعَلْ سَفَرِي هَذَا كَفَّارَةً لِمَا قَبْلَهُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي وَ كُنْ عَوْناً لِي عَلَيْهِ وَ اكْفِنِي وَعْثَهُ وَ مَشَقَّتَهُ وَ لَقِّنِّي مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَ الْعَمَلِ رِضَاكَ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَ بِكَ وَ لَكَ فَإِذَا جَعَلْتَ رِجْلَكَ فِي الرِّكَابِ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِكَ وَ اسْتَوَى بِكَ مَحْمِلُكَ فَقُلْ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا لِلْإِسْلَامِ وَ عَلَّمَنَا الْقُرْآنَ وَ مَنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِمُحَمَّدٍ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَ مَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَ إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْحَامِلُ عَلَى الظَّهْرِ وَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى الْأَمْرِ اللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْنَا بَلَاغاً يَبْلُغُ إِلَى خَيْرٍ بَلَاغاً يَبْلُغُ إِلَى مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رِضْوَانِكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ وَ لَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ وَ لَا حَافِظَ غَيْرُكَ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Safwan Al Jammal, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘He is not ready, the one who decides (to visit) this House (Kabah), when there do not happen to be three characteristics in him – good manners he behaves with, with his companion, or forbearance by which he controls his anger, or piety restraining him from the Prohibitions of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ أَبِي يَقُولُ مَا يُعْبَأُ مَنْ يَؤُمُّ هَذَا الْبَيْتَ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ ثَلَاثُ خِصَالٍ خُلُقٌ يُخَالِقُ بِهِ مَنْ صَحِبَهُ أَوْ حِلْمٌ يَمْلِكُ بِهِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ أَوْ وَرَعٌ يَحْجُزُهُ عَنْ مَحَارِمِ اللَّهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Safwan Al Jammal, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘He is not ready, the one who decides (to visit) this House (Kabah), when there do not happen to be three characteristics in him – good manners he behaves with, with his companion, or forbearance by which he controls his anger, or piety restraining him from the Prohibitions of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/179)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘He is not ready, the one who travels upon this road (to Makkah), when there do not happen to be three characteristics in him – piety restraining him from disobeying Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and forbearance controlling by it, his anger, and good companionship with the one who accompanies him’.

citation.arabic_text: مَا يُعْبَأُ مَنْ يَسْلُكُ هَذَا الطَّرِيقَ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ ثَلَاثُ خِصَالٍ وَرَعٌ يَحْجُزُهُ عَنْ مَعَاصِي اللَّهِ وَ حِلْمٌ يَمْلِكُ بِهِ غَضَبَهُ وَ حُسْنُ الصُّحْبَةِ لِمَنْ صَحِبَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘He is not ready, the one who travels upon this road (to Makkah), when there do not happen to be three characteristics in him – piety restraining him from disobeying Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and forbearance controlling by it, his anger, and good companionship with the one who accompanies him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/179)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawyia Bin Ammar who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Settle yourself upon good companionship with the one who accompanies you with in regard to good mannerisms; and restrain your tongue, and stifle your anger, and lessen your vanities, and roll out your forgiveness, and make yourself generous’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَطِّنْ نَفْسَكَ عَلَى حُسْنِ الصِّحَابَةِ لِمَنْ صَحِبْتَ فِي حُسْنِ خُلُقِكَ وَ كُفَّ لِسَانَكَ وَ اكْظِمْ غَيْظَكَ وَ أَقِلَّ لَغْوَكَ وَ تَفْرُشُ عَفْوَكَ وَ تَسْخُو نَفْسُكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawyia Bin Ammar who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Settle yourself upon good companionship with the one who accompanies you with in regard to good mannerisms; and restrain your tongue, and stifle your anger, and lessen your vanities, and roll out your forgiveness, and make yourself generous’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/180)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Hafs, from Abu Al Rabie Al Shamy who said, ‘We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and the House (Kabah) was crammed with its people. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He is not from us<sup>asws</sup>, the one is not of good companionship with the one who accompanies him, and friendly with the one who is friendly to him, and eats with the one who eats with him, and behaves with the one who behaves with him’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ الْبَيْتُ غَاصٌّ بِأَهْلِهِ فَقَالَ لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يُحْسِنْ صُحْبَةَ مَنْ صَحِبَهُ وَ مُرَافَقَةَ مَنْ رَافَقَهُ وَ مُمَالَحَةَ مَنْ مَالَحَهُ وَ مُخَالَقَةَ مَنْ خَالَقَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ismail Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Hafs, from Abu Al Rabie Al Shamy who said, ‘We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and the House (Kabah) was crammed with its people. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He is not from us<sup>asws</sup>, the one is not of good companionship with the one who accompanies him, and friendly with the one who is friendly to him, and eats with the one who eats with him, and behaves with the one who behaves with him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/180)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘(First select) the comrade, then (embark on) the journey’. And Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not accompany in your journey the one who does not see for you the merit upon him, just as you are seeing the merit for him upon you’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الرَّفِيقَ ثُمَّ السَّفَرَ وَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( صلوات الله عليه ) لَا تَصْحَبَنَّ فِي سَفَرِكَ مَنْ لَا يَرَى لَكَ مِنَ الْفَضْلِ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا تَرَى لَهُ عَلَيْكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘(First select) the comrade, then (embark on) the journey’. And Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not accompany in your journey the one who does not see for you the merit upon him, just as you are seeing the merit for him upon you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/180)

text: Ali, from his father, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Hareyz, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When you accompany, so accompany someone like you, and do not accompany the one who suffices (needless) from you, for in that, is humiliation for the Believer’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا صَحِبْتَ فَاصْحَبْ نَحْوَكَ وَ لَا تَصْحَبَنَّ مَنْ يَكْفِيكَ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ مَذَلَّةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ .
citation.translation: Ali, from his father, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Hareyz, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When you accompany, so accompany someone like you, and do not accompany the one who suffices (needless) from you, for in that, is humiliation for the Believer’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/181)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Al Hassan Bin Al husayn Al lulu’ie, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Huzayfa Bin Mansour, from Shihab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘You<sup>asws</sup> have recognised my (affluent) state and the extent of my (helping) hand and my extending (favours) upon my brethren. So, can I accompany a number of them in the road to Makkah, so that I can extend (favours) upon them?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Don’t do it, O Shihab! If you extend and they extend, you would aggrieve them; and if they withhold, you would (end up) humiliating them. Therefore, accompany your equals’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَدْ عَرَفْتَ حَالِي وَ سَعَةَ يَدِي وَ تَوَسُّعِي عَلَى إِخْوَانِي فَأَصْحَبُ النَّفَرَ مِنْهُمْ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ فَأَتَوَسَّعُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ لَا تَفْعَلْ يَا شِهَابُ إِنْ بَسَطْتَ وَ بَسَطُوا أَجْحَفْتَ بِهِمْ وَ إِنْ أَمْسَكُوا أَذْلَلْتَهُمْ فَاصْحَبْ نُظَرَاءَكَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Al Hassan Bin Al husayn Al lulu’ie, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Huzayfa Bin Mansour, from Shihab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘You<sup>asws</sup> have recognised my (affluent) state and the extent of my (helping) hand and my extending (favours) upon my brethren. So, can I accompany a number of them in the road to Makkah, so that I can extend (favours) upon them?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Don’t do it, O Shihab! If you extend and they extend, you would aggrieve them; and if they withhold, you would (end up) humiliating them. Therefore, accompany your equals’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/181)

text: Ahmad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man goes out along with an affluent group and he is the least of them in things. So the group takes out the expenditure, and he is not able that he should take out the like of what they are taking out’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> do not like it that he should humiliate himself. Let him go out with the ones who are like him’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَخْرُجُ الرَّجُلُ مَعَ قَوْمٍ مَيَاسِيرَ وَ هُوَ أَقَلُّهُمْ شَيْئاً فَيُخْرِجُ الْقَوْمُ النَّفَقَةَ وَ لَا يَقْدِرُ هُوَ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ مِثْلَ مَا أَخْرَجُوا فَقَالَ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ يُذِلَّ نَفْسَهُ لِيَخْرُجْ مَعَ مَنْ هُوَ مِثْلُهُ .
citation.translation: Ahmad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man goes out along with an affluent group and he is the least of them in things. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> do not like it that he should humiliate himself. Let him go out with the ones who are like him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/181)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Huzeyfa Bin Mansour who said, ‘I accompanied Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> was heading towards Makkah. So when he<sup>asws</sup> Prayed, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Free our way, and better our<sup>asws</sup> travelling, and better our health’. And, every time he<sup>asws</sup> ascended a hillock, said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! For You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Nobility over every nobility’.

citation.arabic_text: صَحِبْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ هُوَ مُتَوَجِّهٌ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ خَلِّ سَبِيلَنَا وَ أَحْسِنْ تَسْيِيرَنَا وَ أَحْسِنْ عَافِيَتَنَا وَ كُلَّمَا صَعِدَ أَكَمَةً قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الشَّرَفُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Huzeyfa Bin Mansour who said, ‘I accompanied Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> was heading towards Makkah. So when he<sup>asws</sup> Prayed, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Free our way, and better our<sup>asws</sup> travelling, and better our health’. And, every time he<sup>asws</sup> ascended a hillock, said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! For You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Nobility over every nobility’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/181)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww, in a journey of hissaww, whenever hesaww descended, Glorified (Allahazwj), and whenever hesaww ascended, exclaimed Greatness (of Allahazwj – Takbeer)’.

citation.arabic_text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فِي سَفَرِهِ إِذَا هَبَطَ سَبَّحَ وَ إِذَا صَعِدَ كَبَّرَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww, in a journey of hissaww, whenever hesaww descended, Glorified (Allahazwj), and whenever hesaww ascended, exclaimed Greatness (of Allahazwj – Takbeer)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/182)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Qasim Al Sayrafi, from Hafs Bin Al Qasim who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon the height of every bridge is a devil<sup>la</sup>. So whenever you end up to it, say, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, he<sup>la</sup> would move away from you’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ عَلَى ذِرْوَةِ كُلِّ جِسْرٍ شَيْطَانٌ فَإِذَا انْتَهَيْتَ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ يَرْحَلْ عَنْكَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Qasim Al Sayrafi, from Hafs Bin Al Qasim who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon the height of every bridge is a devil<sup>la</sup>. So whenever you end up to it, say, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, he<sup>la</sup> would move away from you’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/182)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, from Isa Bin Abdullah Al qummi, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> for the conviction for myself, and the Forgiveness, and the good health in the world and the Hereafter. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! You<sup>azwj</sup> are my Reliable One, and You<sup>azwj</sup> are my Hope, and You<sup>azwj</sup> are my backbone, and You<sup>azwj</sup> are my Helper. With You<sup>azwj</sup> I disembark and with You<sup>azwj</sup> do I travel’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And the one who goes out alone in a journey, so let him say, ‘Whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires. There is no Strength except by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Comfort me in my fear, and Support me upon my loneliness, and End my absence (from home)’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ لِنَفْسِيَ الْيَقِينَ وَ الْعَفْوَ وَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ ثِقَتِي وَ أَنْتَ رَجَائِي وَ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي وَ أَنْتَ نَاصِرِي بِكَ أَحُلُّ وَ بِكَ أَسِيرُ قَالَ وَ مَنْ يَخْرُجْ فِي سَفَرٍ وَحْدَهُ فَلْيَقُلْ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ آنِسْ وَحْشَتِي وَ أَعِنِّي عَلَى وَحْدَتِي وَ أَدِّ غَيْبَتِي .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, from Isa Bin Abdullah Al qummi, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! With You<sup>azwj</sup> I disembark and with You<sup>azwj</sup> do I travel’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And the one who goes out alone in a journey, so let him say, ‘Whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires. There is no Strength except by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>.
