text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Fazl Bin Yunus, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is neither a Hajj upon the owned slave, nor an Umra, until he is freed’.

citation.arabic_text: لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمَمْلُوكِ حَجٌّ وَ لَا عُمْرَةٌ حَتَّى يُعْتَقَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Fazl Bin Yunus, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘There is neither a Hajj upon the owned slave, nor an Umra, until he is freed’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/211)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about boys of ours who entered Makkah along with us for Umra, and they went out with us to Arafaat without being in Ihraam. Heasws said: ‘Say to them that they should be washing, then they should be wearing Ihraam, and you should be slaughtering on their behalf just as you are slaughtering for your own selves’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ غِلْمَانٍ لَنَا دَخَلُوا مَعَنَا مَكَّةَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَ خَرَجُوا مَعَنَا إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ بِغَيْرِ إِحْرَامٍ قَالَ قُلْ لَهُمْ يَغْتَسِلُونَ ثُمَّ يُحْرِمُونَ وَ اذْبَحُوا عَنْهُمْ كَمَا تَذْبَحُونَ عَنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ .

Heasws said: ‘Say to them that they should be washing, then they should be wearing Ihraam, and you should be slaughtering on their behalf just as you are slaughtering for your own selves’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/211)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Everything which the slave commits while he is in Ihraam, so it (expiation) is upon the master when he permits to him to be in the Ihraam’.

citation.arabic_text: كُلُّ مَا أَصَابَ الْعَبْدُ وَ هُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فِي إِحْرَامِهِ فَهُوَ عَلَى السَّيِّدِ إِذَا أَذِنَ لَهُ فِي الْإِحْرَامِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Everything which the slave commits while he is in Ihraam, so it (expiation) is upon the master when he permits to him to be in the Ihraam’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/211)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hama, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahimas (7th Imamasws), said, ‘I asked himasws about a slave of ours whom I brought out along with me, and I ordered him, so he performed Tamatto, and began with the hajj on the day of Al-Tarwiyya (8th Zilhajj), and I did not slaughter on his behalf. Is it for him that he Fasts after the leaving, and the days had passed, those which Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Spoken of?’ So heasws said: ‘Why did you not order him that he should perform the exclusive Hajj?’ I said, ‘I sought the goodness’. So heasws said: ‘Just as you sought the goodness, so slaughter a fat sheep, and that would be during the last of the days of leaving’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ غُلَامٍ لَنَا خَرَجْتُ بِهِ مَعِي وَ أَمَرْتُهُ فَتَمَتَّعَ وَ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ وَ لَمْ أَذْبَحْ عَنْهُ أَ لَهُ أَنْ يَصُومَ بَعْدَ النَّفْرِ وَ قَدْ ذَهَبَتِ الْأَيَّامُ الَّتِي قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَقَالَ أَلَا كُنْتَ أَمَرْتَهُ أَنْ يُفْرِدَ الْحَجَّ قُلْتُ طَلَبْتُ الْخَيْرَ فَقَالَ كَمَا طَلَبْتَ الْخَيْرَ فَاذْبَحْ شَاةً سَمِينَةً وَ كَانَ ذَلِكَ يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ الْأَخِيرِ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, (It has been narrated) from Sama’at who asked about a man who ordered his servants that they should be performing Tamatto, heasws said: ‘It is upon him that he should sacrifice on their behalf’. I said, ‘Supposing if he was to give them the Dirhams, and some of them were to sacrifice, and some of them were to withhold the Dirhams and Fast?’ Heasws said: ‘It would suffice him from them, and he would be with the choice, if he so desires to, he can leave it (the money in their hands)’. Heasws said: ‘And if he has ordered them, and they Fasted, it would have sufficed him from them’.

citation.arabic_text: عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ عَنْهُمْ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْطَاهُمْ دَرَاهِمَ فَبَعْضُهُمْ ضَحَّى وَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَمْسَكَ الدَّرَاهِمَ وَ صَامَ قَالَ قَدْ أَجْزَأَ عَنْهُمْ وَ هُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهَا قَالَ وَ لَوْ أَنَّهُ أَمَرَهُمْ وَ صَامُوا كَانَ قَدْ أَجْزَأَ عَنْهُمْ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, (It has been narrated) from Sama’at who asked about a man who ordered his servants that they should be performing Tamatto, heasws said: ‘It is upon him that he should sacrifice on their behalf’. I said, ‘Supposing if he was to give them the Dirhams, and some of them were to sacrifice, and some of them were to withhold the Dirhams and Fast?’ Heasws said: ‘It would suffice him from them, and he would be with the choice, if he so desires to, he can leave it (the money in their hands)’. Heasws said: ‘And if he has ordered them, and they Fasted, it would have sufficed him from them’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a man who dies and bequeathed that Hajj be performed on his behalf. Heasws said: ‘If he was Saroura (not having had performed Hajj), so it would be from the entirety of his wealth. It would be as the status of the debt, the Obligation; and if he had performed Hajj beforehand, so it would be from his one-third. And, the one who dies and had not performed Hajj of Al-Islam, and he did not leave (anything) except for a measurement of the expenses of the carrier, and there are inheritors for him, so they would be more deserving with what he had left. Thus, if they so desire to, the can consume it, and if they so desire to, they can perform Hajj on his behalf’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ تُوُفِّيَ وَ أَوْصَى أَنْ يُحَجَّ عَنْهُ قَالَ إِنْ كَانَ صَرُورَةً فَمِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ إِنَّهُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الدَّيْنِ الْوَاجِبِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ حَجَّ فَمِنْ ثُلُثِهِ وَ مَنْ مَاتَ وَ لَمْ يَحُجَّ حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ لَمْ يَتْرُكْ إِلَّا قَدْرَ نَفَقَةِ الْحَمُولَةِ وَ لَهُ وَرَثَةٌ فَهُمْ أَحَقُّ بِمَا تَرَكَ فَإِنْ شَاءُوا أَكَلُوا وَ إِنْ شَاءُوا أَحَجُّوا عَنْهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a man who dies and bequeathed that Hajj be performed on his behalf. Heasws said: ‘If he was Saroura (not having had performed Hajj), so it would be from the entirety of his wealth. It would be as the status of the debt, the Obligation; and if he had performed Hajj beforehand, so it would be from his one-third. And, the one who dies and had not performed Hajj of Al-Islam, and he did not leave (anything) except for a measurement of the expenses of the carrier, and there are inheritors for him, so they would be more deserving with what he had left. Thus, if they so desire to, the can consume it, and if they so desire to, they can perform Hajj on his behalf’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/212)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Sa’ad Bin abu Khalaf who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws about the Saroura man (not having had performed Hajj), performing Hajj on behalf of the deceased. Heasws said: ‘Yes. When the Saroura does not find what he can perform Hajj with for himself. So if there was for him what he can perform Hajj with for himself, so he would not be suffice from it until he performs Hajj from his own wealth, and it would be sufficient on behalf of the deceased, whether there happened to be any wealth for the Saroura, or if there did not happen to be any wealth for him’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ الصَّرُورَةِ يَحُجُّ عَنِ الْمَيِّتِ قَالَ نَعَمْ إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدِ الصَّرُورَةُ مَا يَحُجُّ بِهِ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مَا يَحُجُّ بِهِ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَلَيْسَ يُجْزِئُ عَنْهُ حَتَّى يَحُجَّ مِنْ مَالِهِ وَ هِيَ تُجْزِئُ عَنِ الْمَيِّتِ إِنْ كَانَ لِلصَّرُورَةِ مَالٌ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Sa’ad Bin abu Khalaf who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws about the Saroura man (not having had performed Hajj), performing Hajj on behalf of the deceased. Heasws said: ‘Yes. When the Saroura does not find what he can perform Hajj with for himself. So if there was for him what he can perform Hajj with for himself, so he would not be suffice from it until he performs Hajj from his own wealth, and it would be sufficient on behalf of the deceased, whether there happened to be any wealth for the Saroura, or if there did not happen to be any wealth for him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/213)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a Saroura man (not having had performed Hajj), who died and had not performed Hajj of Al-Islam, and for him was wealth’. Heasws said: ‘A Saroura would perform Hajj on his behalf, the one who does not have any wealth for him’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ صَرُورَةٍ مَاتَ وَ لَمْ يَحُجَّ حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ لَهُ مَالٌ قَالَ يَحُجُّ عَنْهُ صَرُورَةٌ لَا مَالَ لَهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a Saroura man (not having had performed Hajj), who died and had not performed Hajj of Al-Islam, and for him was wealth’. Heasws said: ‘A Saroura would perform Hajj on his behalf, the one who does not have any wealth for him’.

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who dies and bequeath with a Hajj. So Dirhams are given to a man to perform Hajj with on his behalf, but he dies before he performs Hajj. Then the Dirhams are given to someone else. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he died in the way, or in Makkah before he had fulfilled his rituals, so it would suffice from the first one’. I said, ‘Supposing he is involved with something which spoils his Hajj upon him until the Hajj of the next year comes to be (Obligatory) upon him, would it suffice him from the first one?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘Is it because the hired one is responsible for the Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ يُوصِي بِحَجَّةٍ فَيُعْطَى رَجُلٌ دَرَاهِمَ يَحُجُّ بِهَا عَنْهُ فَيَمُوتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحُجَّ ثُمَّ أُعْطِيَ الدَّرَاهِمَ غَيْرُهُ قَالَ إِنْ مَاتَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ أَوْ بِمَكَّةَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ مَنَاسِكَهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِئُ عَنِ الْأَوَّلِ قُلْتُ فَإِنِ ابْتُلِيَ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ يُفْسِدُ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّهُ حَتَّى يَصِيرَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَجُّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ أَ يُجْزِئُ عَنِ الْأَوَّلِ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ لِأَنَّ الْأَجِيرَ ضَامِنٌ لِلْحَجِّ قَالَ نَعَمْ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who dies and bequeath with a Hajj. So Dirhams are given to a man to perform Hajj with on his behalf, but he dies before he performs Hajj. Then the Dirhams are given to someone else. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he died in the way, or in Makkah before he had fulfilled his rituals, so it would suffice from the first one’. I said, ‘Supposing he is involved with something which spoils his Hajj upon him until the Hajj of the next year comes to be (Obligatory) upon him, would it suffice him from the first one?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘Is it because the hired one is responsible for the Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/214)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who give a man what he can perform Hajj with, so an event (of death) occurs with the man. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was such that he went out and was hit in one of the roads, so it would suffice from the former (deceased), or else, so no’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ أَعْطَى رَجُلًا مَا يَحُجُّهُ فَحَدَثَ بِالرَّجُلِ حَدَثٌ فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَ خَرَجَ فَأَصَابَهُ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ فَقَدْ أَجْزَأَتْ عَنِ الْأَوَّلِ وَ إِلَّا فَلَا .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who give a man what he can perform Hajj with, so an event (of death) occurs with the man. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was such that he went out and was hit in one of the roads, so it would suffice from the former (deceased), or else, so no’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/215)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ali Bin Al numan, from Suweyd Al Qala’a, from Ayoub, from Bureyd Al Ijaly, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man whom entrusted wealth to me, so he dies, and there was nothing for his children, and he had not performed Hajj, the Hajj of Al-Islam. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Perform Hajj on his behalf, and whatever is excess, so give it to them (the dependents of the deceased)’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ اسْتَوْدَعَنِي مَالًا فَهَلَكَ وَ لَيْسَ لِوُلْدِهِ شَيْ‏ءٌ وَ لَمْ يَحُجَّ حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ حُجَّ عَنْهُ وَ مَا فَضَلَ فَأَعْطِهِمْ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ali Bin Al numan, from Suweyd Al Qala’a, from Ayoub, from Bureyd Al Ijaly, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man whom entrusted wealth to me, so he dies, and there was nothing for his children, and he had not performed Hajj, the Hajj of Al-Islam. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Perform Hajj on his behalf, and whatever is excess, so give it to them (the dependents of the deceased)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/215)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Musadif, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Saroura woman (not having had performed Hajj) who performs Hajj on behalf of the Saroura man (not having had performed Hajj). So heasws said: ‘If she had performed Hajj beforehand, and she was a Muslim, an understanding one (فَقِيهَةً). Sometimes, a woman is of more understanding than a man’.

citation.arabic_text: الْمَرْأَةِ تَحُجُّ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ الصَّرُورَةِ فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَتْ قَدْ حَجَّتْ وَ كَانَتْ مُسْلِمَةً فَقِيهَةً فَرُبَّ امْرَأَةٍ أَفْقَهُ مِنْ رَجُلٍ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Musadif, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Saroura woman (not having had performed Hajj) who performs Hajj on behalf of the Saroura man (not having had performed Hajj). So heasws said: ‘If she had performed Hajj beforehand, and she was a Muslim, an understanding one (فَقِيهَةً). Sometimes, a woman is of more understanding than a man’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/216)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man performs Hajj on behalf of the woman, and the woman performs Hajj on behalf of the man’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) الرَّجُلُ يَحُجُّ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ وَ الْمَرْأَةُ تَحُجُّ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ قَالَ لَا بَأْسَ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/216)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A woman of our family, a brother of hers died and bequeathed with Hajj, and the woman had performed Hajj beforehand, so she said, ‘If I am well, I shall perform Hajj on behalf of my brother, and I am more rightful with it than others’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem if she were to perform Hajj on behalf of her brother; and if there was wealth for her, so let her perform Hajj from her own wealth, for it would be greater for her Recompense’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِنَا مَاتَ أَخُوهَا فَأَوْصَى بِحَجَّةٍ وَ قَدْ حَجَّتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فَقَالَتْ إِنْ صَلَحَ حَجَجْتُ أَنَا عَنْ أَخِي وَ كُنْتُ أَنَا أَحَقَّ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِي فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) لَا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تَحُجَّ عَنْ أَخِيهَا وَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهَا مَالٌ فَلْتَحُجَّ مِنْ مَالِهَا فَإِنَّهُ أَعْظَمُ لِأَجْرِهَا .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A woman of our family, a brother of hers died and bequeathed with Hajj, and the woman had performed Hajj beforehand, so she said, ‘If I am well, I shall perform Hajj on behalf of my brother, and I am more rightful with it than others’. text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Rafa’at, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The woman can perform Hajj on behalf of her brother and on behalf of her sister’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The woman can perform Hajj on behalf of her son’.

citation.arabic_text: تَحُجُّ الْمَرْأَةُ عَنْ أَخِيهَا وَ عَنْ أُخْتِهَا وَ قَالَ تَحُجُّ الْمَرْأَةُ عَنِ ابْنِهَا .

And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The woman can perform Hajj on behalf of her son’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, fom Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imamasws) regarding a man who gives Dirhams to a man to perform Hajj on his behalf, an exclusive Hajj. Would it suffice for him if he were to perform Tamatto with the Umra to the Hajj?’ So heasws said: ‘Yes. But rather, he would have opposed him to perform the more meritorious one’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ أَعْطَى رَجُلًا دَرَاهِمَ يَحُجُّ بِهَا عَنْهُ حَجَّةً مُفْرَدَةً أَ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَمَتَّعَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ إِنَّمَا خَالَفَهُ إِلَى الْفَضْلِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, fom Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imamasws) regarding a man who gives Dirhams to a man to perform Hajj on his behalf, an exclusive Hajj. text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Hareyz who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who gives (money) to a man who had performed Hajj, to perform Hajj with it on his behalf from Al-Kufa, but he performs Hajj on his behalf from Al-Basra. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem. When he fulfills the entirety of his rituals so he would have completed his Hajj’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَعْطَى رَجُلًا حَجَّةً يَحُجُّ بِهَا عَنْهُ مِنَ الْكُوفَةِ فَحَجَّ عَنْهُ مِنَ الْبَصْرَةِ قَالَ لَا بَأْسَ إِذَا قَضَى جَمِيعَ مَنَاسِكِهِ فَقَدْ تَمَّ حَجُّهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Hareyz who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who gives (money) to a man who had performed Hajj, to perform Hajj with it on his behalf from Al-Kufa, but he performs Hajj on his behalf from Al-Basra. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem. When he fulfills the entirety of his rituals so he would have completed his Hajj’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/218)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Zakariyya Bin Adam who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about a man who died and bequeathed with a Hajj. Is it allowed that Hajj be performed on his behalf from another city than the one which he died in?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whatever was besides the juncture, so there is no problem’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ أَوْصَى بِحَجَّةٍ أَ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يُحَجَّ عَنْهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ الْبَلَدِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ مَا كَانَ دُونَ الْمِيقَاتِ فَلَا بَأْسَ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Zakariyya Bin Adam who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about a man who died and bequeathed with a Hajj. Is it allowed that Hajj be performed on his behalf from another city than the one which he died in?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Whatever was besides the juncture, so there is no problem’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/219)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sandy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Aban Bin Usman, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said regarding a man who bequeathed with a Hajj, but did not have sufficiency (of funds) to perform it from Al-Kufa, that it would suffice for him to perform Hajj from besides the juncture’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فِي رَجُلٍ أُوصِيَ بِحَجَّةٍ فَلَمْ تَكْفِهِ مِنَ الْكُوفَةِ إِنَّهَا تُجْزِئُ حَجَّتُهُ مِنْ دُونِ الْوَقْتِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Salih Bin Al Sandy, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Aban Bin Usman, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said regarding a man who bequeathed with a Hajj, but did not have sufficiency (of funds) to perform it from Al-Kufa, that it would suffice for him to perform Hajj from besides the juncture’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/219)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the man who dies, so he bequeaths with the Hajj, from where should the Hajj be performed on his behalf?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon the measurement of his wealth. If there is capacity in his wealth, so from his house, and if there is no capacity in his wealth for it to be performed from his house, then from Al-Kufa. So if there is no capacity for it to be performed from Al-Kufa, so from Al-Medina’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ فَيُوصِي بِالْحَجِّ مِنْ أَيْنَ يُحَجُّ عَنْهُ قَالَ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَالِهِ إِنْ وَسِعَهُ مَالُهُ فَمِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَسَعْهُ مَالُهُ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ فَمِنَ الْكُوفَةِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسَعْهُ مِنَ الْكُوفَةِ فَمِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the man who dies, so he bequeaths with the Hajj, from where should the Hajj be performed on his behalf?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon the measurement of his wealth. If there is capacity in his wealth, so from his house, and if there is no capacity in his wealth for it to be performed from his house, then from Al-Kufa. So if there is no capacity for it to be performed from Al-Kufa, so from Al-Medina’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/220)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahmoun, from Ibn Raib, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a man who bequeaths that Hajj be performed on his behalf, the Hajj of Al-Islam, but the entirety of what he left did not reach (the required amount), except for fifty Dirhams. Heasws said: ‘He should perform Hajj on his behalf from one of the junctures which Rasool-Allahsaww used as a juncture (to wear Ihraam), from nearby’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى أَنْ يُحَجَّ عَنْهُ حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ فَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ جَمِيعُ مَا تَرَكَ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ دِرْهَماً قَالَ يُحَجُّ عَنْهُ مِنْ بَعْضِ الْأَوْقَاتِ الَّتِي وَقَّتَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مِنْ قُرْبٍ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahmoun, from Ibn Raib, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a man who bequeaths that Hajj be performed on his behalf, the Hajj of Al-Islam, but the entirety of what he left did not reach (the required amount), except for fifty Dirhams. Heasws said: ‘He should perform Hajj on his behalf from one of the junctures which Rasool-Allahsaww used as a juncture (to wear Ihraam), from nearby’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/220)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, or from a man, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Saeed, (It has been narrated) from the one who asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who bequeathed twenty Dirhams regarding Hajj. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A man should perform Hajj with it from a place where its required expenditure would suffice it’.

citation.arabic_text: حَجَّةٍ قَالَ يَحُجُّ بِهَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ مَوْضِعٍ بَلَغَهُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, or from a man, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Saeed, (It has been narrated) from the one who asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who bequeathed twenty Dirhams regarding Hajj. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A man should perform Hajj with it from a place where its required expenditure would suffice it’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Ismail who said, ‘I instructed a man to aske Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the man who takes (the responsibility for performing) a Hajj, but is not (paid) sufficiently. Is it for him that he takes (more) from another man and increase the capacity with it, and he would suffice from both of them together, or participate both of them if it is not sufficient from one of the two? So he mentioned that he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It would be more beloved to me<sup>asws</sup> if it happens to be unmixed for one. And if it does not happen to suffice him, so he should not take it’.

citation.arabic_text: أَمَرْتُ رَجُلًا يَسْأَلُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ رَجُلٍ حَجَّةً فَلَا تَكْفِيهِ أَ لَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ مِنْ رَجُلٍ أُخْرَى وَ يَتَّسِعَ بِهَا وَ يُجْزِئُ عَنْهُمَا جَمِيعاً أَوْ يُشْرِكُهُمَا جَمِيعاً إِنْ لَمْ تَكْفِهِ إِحْدَاهُمَا فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ خَالِصَةً لِوَاحِدٍ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَا تَكْفِيهِ فَلَا يَأْخُذْهَا .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Ismail who said, ‘I instructed a man to aske Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the man who takes (the responsibility for performing) a Hajj, but is not (paid) sufficiently. So he mentioned that he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It would be more beloved to me<sup>asws</sup> if it happens to be unmixed for one. And if it does not happen to suffice him, so he should not take it’.

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Ja’far Al Ahowl, from Usman Bin Isa who said, ‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding the man who gives the (responsibility of performing) the Hajj, but he hands it over to someone else?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with it’.

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Mohsan Bin Ahmad, from Aban, from Umar Bin Yazeed who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man bequeaths with a Hajj, but he does not (pay) sufficiently for it’. text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Wahab Bin Abd Rabbih who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Can the man perform Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi (Hostile one)?’ So heasws said: ‘No’. I said, ‘Supposing it was my father?’ Heasws said: ‘So if it was your father, then yes’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَ يَحُجُّ الرَّجُلُ عَنِ النَّاصِبِ فَقَالَ لَا فَقُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَبِي قَالَ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَبَاكَ فَنَعَمْ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Mahziyar who said, ‘I wrote to himasws, ‘The man performs Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi (Hostile one), would there be a sin upon him when he performs Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi (Hostile one), and would that be beneficial to the Nasibi (Hostile one) or not?’ So heasws wrote: ‘Do not perform Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi (Hostile one), nor perform Hajj with him’.

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلُ يَحُجُّ عَنِ النَّاصِبِ هَلْ عَلَيْهِ إِثْمٌ إِذَا حَجَّ عَنِ النَّاصِبِ وَ هَلْ يَنْفَعُ ذَلِكَ النَّاصِبَ أَمْ لَا فَكَتَبَ لَا يَحُجَّ عَنِ النَّاصِبِ وَ لَا يَحُجَّ بِهِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Mahziyar who said, ‘I wrote to himasws, ‘The man performs Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi (Hostile one), would there be a sin upon him when he performs Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi (Hostile one), and would that be beneficial to the Nasibi (Hostile one) or not?’ So heasws wrote: ‘Do not perform Hajj on behalf of the Nasibi (Hostile one), nor perform Hajj with him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/222)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from the one who narrated it, from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> that, ‘The one in your<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah, Ali Bin Mahziyar, bequeathed that Hajj be performed on his behalf from a village, a quarter of it being for you<sup>asws</sup>, during every year, one Hajj, up to (expenditure of) twenty Dinars, and the road of Al-Basra is cut off, so the expenditure has increased upon the people, therefore it cannot be sufficed by twenty Dinars. And, a number of the ones in your<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah have bequeathed similarly with regards to their Hajj’. So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘So make (expenditure of) three Hajjs to be for two Hajjs, (and that would suffice) Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’.

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَنَّ مَوْلَاكَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ مَهْزِيَارَ أَوْصَى أَنْ يُحَجَّ عَنْهُ مِنْ ضَيْعَةٍ صَيَّرَ رُبُعَهَا لَكَ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ حَجَّةً إِلَى عِشْرِينَ دِينَاراً وَ أَنَّهُ قَدِ انْقَطَعَ طَرِيقُ الْبَصْرَةِ فَتَضَاعَفُ الْمَئُونَةُ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَلَيْسَ يَكْتَفُونَ بِعِشْرِينَ دِينَاراً وَ كَذَلِكَ أَوْصَى عِدَّةٌ مِنْ مَوَالِيكَ فِي حِجَجِهِمْ فَكَتَبَ يُجْعَلُ ثَلَاثُ حِجَجٍ حَجَّتَيْنِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from the one who narrated it, from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> that, ‘The one in your<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah, Ali Bin Mahziyar, bequeathed that Hajj be performed on his behalf from a village, a quarter of it being for you<sup>asws</sup>, during every year, one Hajj, up to (expenditure of) twenty Dinars, and the road of Al-Basra is cut off, so the expenditure has increased upon the people, therefore it cannot be sufficed by twenty Dinars. And, a number of the ones in your<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah have bequeathed similarly with regards to their Hajj’. So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘So make (expenditure of) three Hajjs to be for two Hajjs, (and that would suffice) Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’.

text: Ibrahim said, ‘And Ali Bin Muhammad Al-Husayni wrote to him<sup>asws</sup> that, ‘A cousin of mine bequeathed that Hajj be performed on his behalf with twenty five Dinars during every year, but it does not suffice, so what are your<sup>asws</sup> orders regarding that?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘He should make (the expenditure of) two Hajjs to be regarding one Hajj (to be sufficient), Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing. citation.arabic_text: وَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْحُصَيْنِيُّ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَمِّي أَوْصَى أَنْ يُحَجَّ عَنْهُ بِخَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ دِينَاراً فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ فَلَيْسَ يَكْفِي فَمَا تَأْمُرُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَكَتَبَ يَجْعَلُ حَجَّتَيْنِ فِي حَجَّةٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَالِمٌ بِذَلِكَ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Abdul Kareem, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I said to himasws, ‘The man performs Hajj on behalf of his brother, or on behalf of his father, or on behalf of a man from the people. Is it befitting for him that he should be saying something?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. He should be saying after having worn the Ihraam, ‘O Allahazwj! Whatever hits me during this journey of mine, from fatigue, or difficulties, or affliction, or untidiness, so Recompense so and so with regards to it, and Recompense me for fulfilling it on his behalf’. Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Al Halby – similar to it’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ يَحُجُّ عَنْ أَخِيهِ أَوْ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَوْ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ هَلْ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ يَقُولُ بَعْدَ مَا يُحْرِمُ اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصَابَنِي فِي سَفَرِي هَذَا مِنْ تَعَبٍ أَوْ شِدَّةٍ أَوْ بَلَاءٍ أَوْ شَعَثٍ فَأْجُرْ فُلَاناً فِيهِ وَ أْجُرْنِي فِي قَضَائِي عَنْهُ . مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ مِثْلَهُ .

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What is Obligatory upon the one who performs Hajj on behalf of another man?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should name him in the places and the junctures’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لَهُ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَى الَّذِي يَحُجُّ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ قَالَ يُسَمِّيهِ فِي الْمَوَاطِنِ وَ الْمَوَاقِفِ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘It was said to himasws, ‘What is yourasws view about the one who fulfils (Hajj) on behalf of his father, or his mother, or his brothers, or other than them, should he be saying something?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. citation.arabic_text: قِيلَ لَهُ أَ رَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَقْضِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَوْ أُمِّهِ أَوْ أَخِيهِ أَوْ غَيْرِهِمْ أَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ إِحْرَامِهِ اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصَابَنِي مِنْ نَصَبٍ أَوْ شَعَثٍ أَوْ شِدَّةٍ فَأْجُرْ فُلَاناً فِيهِ وَ أْجُرْنِي فِي قَضَائِي عَنْهُ .

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin yahya, from Yahya Al Arzaq who said, ‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man performs Hajj on behalf of the man, would it be correct for him if he were to circumambulate on behalf of his relatives?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When he fulfils the rituals of the Hajj, so let him do whatever he so desires to’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) الرَّجُلُ يَحُجُّ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَطُوفَ عَنْ أَقَارِبِهِ فَقَالَ إِذَا قَضَى مَنَاسِكَ الْحَجِّ فَلْيَصْنَعْ مَا شَاءَ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a man who gave wealth to a man to perform Hajj on his behalf, but he performed Hajj for himself. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It would be (Reckoned as being) on behalf of the owner of the wealth’.

citation.arabic_text: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَعْطَى رَجُلًا مَالًا يَحُجُّ عَنْهُ فَحَجَّ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَقَالَ هِيَ عَنْ صَاحِبِ الْمَالِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was asked about a man who gave wealth to a man to perform Hajj on his behalf, but he performed Hajj for himself. text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his men, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who took wealth from a man and did not perform Hajj on his behalf, and died, and did not leave anything. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was such that the hired one had performed (his own) Hajj, his Hajj would be seized and handed over to the owner of the wealth. And, if had not performed Hajj, (even then) the Rewards of the Hajj would be Written for the owner of the wealth’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ أَخَذَ مِنْ رَجُلٍ مَالًا وَ لَمْ يَحُجَّ عَنْهُ وَ مَاتَ لَمْ يُخَلِّفْ شَيْئاً قَالَ إِنْ كَانَ حَجَّ الْأَجِيرُ أُخِذَتْ حَجَّتُهُ وَ دُفِعَتْ إِلَى صَاحِبِ الْمَالِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ حَجَّ كُتِبَ لِصَاحِبِ الْمَالِ ثَوَابُ الْحَجِّ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from a man from our companions called Abdul Rahman Bin Sinan who said, ‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, when a man came over to him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> gave him thirty Dinars to perform Hajj with it on behalf of Ismail, and he<sup>asws</sup> did not leave anything from the Umra to the Hajj, except that he<sup>asws</sup> stipulated upon him, to the extent that he<sup>asws</sup> stipulated upon him that he should be walking briskly from the valley of Muhassar. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O you! When you do this, it would be a Hajj for Ismail with whatever is spent from his wealth, and for you would be nine (times as much) with what you exhaust yourself from your body’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِذْ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ فَأَعْطَاهُ ثَلَاثِينَ دِينَاراً يَحُجُّ بِهَا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَ لَمْ يَتْرُكْ شَيْئاً مِنَ الْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ إِلَّا اشْتَرَطَهُ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى اشْتَرَطَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَسْعَى عَنْ وَادِي مُحَسِّرٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا هَذَا إِذَا أَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا كَانَ لِإِسْمَاعِيلَ حَجَّةٌ بِمَا أَنْفَقَ مِنْ مَالِهِ وَ كَانَ لَكَ تِسْعٌ بِمَا أَتْعَبْتَ مِنْ بَدَنِكَ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Ali Bin Yusuf, from Abu Abdullah Al momin, from Ibn Muskan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man performs Hajj on behalf of another, what would be for him, from the Recompense and the Rewards?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the one who performs Hajj on behalf of another man would be Recompense and Rewards of ten Hajjs’.

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from the one who mentioned it, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Yaqteen who said, ‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man handed over (the responsibility of performing) one Hajj to five people, so he said, ‘Perform Hajj with it’. So I said, ‘For whom would be the Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the one who Prayed in the heat and the cold’.

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Al Qummy who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the man who is given (the responsibility of performing the) Hajj. He performs Hajj with it and spends liberally upon himself, but there remains excess from it. Should he return it back to him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No. It is for him’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُعْطَى الْحَجَّةَ يَحُجُّ بِهَا وَ يُوَسِّعُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَيَفْضُلُ مِنْهَا أَ يَرُدُّهَا عَلَيْهِ قَالَ لَا هِيَ لَهُ

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Bin Musa Al Sabaty, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who takes the Dirhams from a man in order to perform Hajj with it. Is it allowed for him that he should spend from it in other than the Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When he took the responsibility for the Hajj, so the Dirhams are for him. He can do with these whatever he so likes to, and upon him is the performance of the Hajj’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْخُذُ الدَّرَاهِمَ لِيَحُجَّ بِهَا عَنْ رَجُلٍ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يُنْفِقَ مِنْهَا فِي غَيْرِ الْحَجِّ قَالَ إِذَا ضَمِنَ الْحَجَّ فَالدَّرَاهِمُ لَهُ يَصْنَعُ بِهَا مَا أَحَبَّ وَ عَلَيْهِ حَجَّةٌ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Bin Musa Al Sabaty, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who takes the Dirhams from a man in order to perform Hajj with it. Is it allowed for him that he should spend from it in other than the Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When he took the responsibility for the Hajj, so the Dirhams are for him. He can do with these whatever he so likes to, and upon him is the performance of the Hajj’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/228)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘Amar Bin Yazeed sent me to Abu Ja’far Al Ahowl with Dirhams and said, ‘Say to him that I intend the Hajj to be performed with it, so let him perform Hajj. And, if he intends to spend it, so let him spend it’. So I spent it and did not perform Hajj’. Hammad said, ‘So our companions mentioned that to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You have found the understanding Sheykh’.

citation.arabic_text: بَعَثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ بِدَرَاهِمَ وَ قَالَ قُلْ لَهُ إِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَحُجَّ بِهَا فَلْيَحُجَّ وَ إِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُنْفِقَهَا فَلْيُنْفِقْهَا قَالَ فَأَنْفَقَهَا وَ لَمْ يَحُجَّ قَالَ حَمَّادٌ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ أَصْحَابُنَا لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَالَ وَجَدْتُمُ الشَّيْخَ فَقِيهاً .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Musa Bin Al Qasim Al Bajaly who said, ‘I said to Abu Ja’farasws, ‘O my Masterasws! I hope to be Fasting in Al-Medina in a month of Ramazan’. So heasws said: ‘You will Fast in it, Allahazwj Willing’. I said, ‘And I am hoping that our exit takes place in the 10th of Shawwal, and I would have visited Rasool-Allahsaww, and the Peopleasws of hissaww Household, and visited youasws. So, sometimes I perform Hajj on behalf of yourasws fatherasws, and sometimes I perform Hajj on behalf of my father, and sometimes I perform Hajj on behalf of the man from my brethren, and sometimes I perform Hajj for myself. So how should I be doing it?’ So heasws said: ‘Tamatto’. So I said, ‘I am staying in Makkah since the last ten years’. So heasws said: ‘Tamatto’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) يَا سَيِّدِي إِنِّي أَرْجُو أَنْ أَصُومَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ فَقَالَ تَصُومُ بِهَا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ قُلْتُ وَ أَرْجُو أَنْ يَكُونَ خُرُوجُنَا فِي عَشْرٍ مِنْ شَوَّالٍ وَ قَدْ عَوَّدَ اللَّهُ زِيَارَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ زِيَارَتَكَ فَرُبَّمَا حَجَجْتُ عَنْ أَبِيكَ وَ رُبَّمَا حَجَجْتُ عَنْ أَبِي وَ رُبَّمَا حَجَجْتُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ مِنْ إِخْوَانِي وَ رُبَّمَا حَجَجْتُ عَنْ نَفْسِي فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعْ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي مُقِيمٌ بِمَكَّةَ مُنْذُ عَشْرِ سِنِينَ فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعْ .

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Musa Bin Al Qasim who said, ‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup> (9<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) ‘I intended to circumambulate on your<sup>asws</sup> behalf and on behalf of your<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>. So it was said to me: ‘The successors<sup>asws</sup> are such that circumambulations are not to be performed on their<sup>asws</sup> behalf’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘But, circumambulate whatever you are able to, for it is allowed’. Then, I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, after three years, ‘I had sought your<sup>asws</sup> permission regarding the circumambulation on your<sup>asws</sup> behalf, and on behalf of your<sup>asws</sup> father, so you<sup>asws</sup> permitted to me with regards to that. So I circumambulated on behalf of you<sup>asws</sup> both what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desired. Then something occurred in my heart, so I acted by it’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And what was it?’ I said, ‘I circumambulated one day, on behalf of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said three times: ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Send Blessings upon Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’. Then on the second day, on behalf of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>. Then one the third day I circumambulated on behalf of Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>; and on the fourth day on behalf of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>; and on the fifth day on behalf of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>; and on the sixth day on behalf of Abu Ja’far Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>; and on the seventh day on behalf of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>; and on the eight day on behalf of your<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> Musa<sup>asws</sup>; and on the ninth day on behalf of your<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> Ali<sup>asws</sup> (Al Reza)<sup>asws</sup>, and on the tenth day on your<sup>asws</sup> behalf, my Master<sup>asws</sup>. And they<sup>asws</sup> are those whom I make to be a Religion of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, by their<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, you have made a Religion of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with the Religion which He<sup>azwj</sup> will not be Accepting from the servants, apart from it’. I said, ‘And sometimes I circumambulate on behalf of your<sup>asws</sup> mother<sup>asws</sup> Fatima<sup>asws</sup>, and sometimes I do not circumambulate’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Frequent from this, for it would be the most superior of what you act upon, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِي ( عليه السلام ) قَدْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَطُوفَ عَنْكَ وَ عَنْ أَبِيكَ فَقِيلَ لِي إِنَّ الْأَوْصِيَاءَ لَا يُطَافُ عَنْهُمْ فَقَالَ لِي بَلْ طُفْ مَا أَمْكَنَكَ فَإِنَّهُ جَائِزٌ ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لَهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِثَلَاثِ سِنِينَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْذَنْتُكَ فِي الطَّوَافِ عَنْكَ وَ عَنْ أَبِيكَ فَأَذِنْتَ لِي فِي ذَلِكَ فَطُفْتُ عَنْكُمَا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ وَقَعَ فِي قَلْبِي شَيْ‏ءٌ فَعَمِلْتُ بِهِ قَالَ وَ مَا هُوَ قُلْتُ طُفْتُ يَوْماً عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فَقَالَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ الْيَوْمَ الثَّانِيَ عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ثُمَّ طُفْتُ الْيَوْمَ الثَّالِثَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ الرَّابِعَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ الْخَامِسَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ السَّادِسَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) وَ الْيَوْمَ السَّابِعَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ ( عليه السلام ) وَ الْيَوْمَ الثَّامِنَ عَنْ أَبِيكَ مُوسَى ( عليه السلام ) وَ الْيَوْمَ التَّاسِعَ عَنْ أَبِيكَ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) وَ الْيَوْمَ الْعَاشِرَ عَنْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَدِينُ اللَّهَ بِوَلَايَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ إِذَنْ وَ اللَّهِ تَدِينَ اللَّهَ بِالدِّينِ الَّذِي لَا يَقْبَلُ مِنَ الْعِبَادِ غَيْرَهُ قُلْتُ وَ رُبَّمَا طُفْتُ عَنْ أُمِّكَ فَاطِمَةَ ( عليها السلام ) وَ رُبَّمَا لَمْ أَطُفْ فَقَالَ اسْتَكْثِرْ مِنْ هَذَا فَإِنَّهُ أَفْضَلُ مَا أَنْتَ عَامِلُهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Can I participate my parents in my Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘Can I participate my brethren in my Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Made Hajj to be for you and Hajj to be for them, and for you would be a Recompense for your linking them’. I said, ‘So, can I circumambulate on behalf of the man and the woman and they are in Al-Kufa?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. You should be saying when you begin the circumambulation, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Accept from so and so, on whose behalf I am circumambulating’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لَهُ أُشْرِكُ أَبَوَيَّ فِي حَجَّتِي قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ أُشْرِكُ إِخْوَتِي فِي حَجَّتِي قَالَ نَعَمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ جَاعِلٌ لَكَ حَجّاً وَ لَهُمْ حَجّاً وَ لَكَ أَجْرٌ لِصِلَتِكَ إِيَّاهُمْ قُلْتُ فَأَطُوفُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ وَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَ هُمْ بِالْكُوفَةِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ تَقُولُ حِينَ تَفْتَتِحُ الطَّوَافَ اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنْ فُلَانٍ الَّذِي تَطُوفُ عَنْهُ .

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from one of our companions, from Amro Bin Ilyas who said, ‘I performed Hajj along with my father, and I was a Saroura (not having had performed Hajj). So I said, ‘I would love it to make my Hajj to be on behalf of my mother who has died’. So he said to me, ‘(Wait) until I ask Abu Abdullahasws for you’. So Ilyas said to Abu Abdullahasws, and I was listening, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! This son of mine is a Saroura (not having had performed Hajj), and his mother has died, So he would like to make his Hajj to be for her. Is that allowed for him?’ So Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘It would be Written for him, and for her, and it would be Written for him the Recompense of the righteous deed’.

citation.arabic_text: حَجَجْتُ مَعَ أَبِي وَ أَنَا صَرُورَةٌ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَجْعَلَ حَجَّتِي عَنْ أُمِّي فَإِنَّهَا قَدْ مَاتَتْ قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي حَتَّى أَسْأَلَ لَكَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَالَ إِلْيَاسُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ ابْنِي هَذَا صَرُورَةٌ وَ قَدْ مَاتَتْ أُمُّهُ فَأَحَبَّ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ حَجَّتَهُ لَهَا أَ فَيَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يُكْتَبُ لَهُ وَ لَهَا وَ يُكْتَبُ لَهُ أَجْرُ الْبِرِّ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Safwan Al Jammal who said, ‘I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so Al-Haris Bin Al-Mugheira came over to him<sup>asws</sup>, and he said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May my father be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>, and my mother! For me is a daughter who stands for me upon everything, and she is a first-born. Can I make my Hajj to be for her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Its Recompense would happen to be for her, and there would happen to be for you the like of that, and there would not be a reduction from its Recompense, of anything’.

citation.arabic_text: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ فَقَالَ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَ أُمِّي لِيَ ابْنَةٌ قَيِّمَةٌ لِي عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ هِيَ عَاتِقٌ أَ فَأَجْعَلُ لَهَا حَجَّتِي قَالَ أَمَا إِنَّهُ يَكُونُ لَهَا أَجْرُهَا وَ يَكُونُ لَكَ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَ لَا يُنْقَصُ مِنْ أَجْرِهَا شَيْ‏ءٌ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Safwan Al Jammal who said, ‘I went over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so Al-Haris Bin Al-Mugheira came over to him<sup>asws</sup>, and he said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May my father be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>, and my mother! For me is a daughter who stands for me upon everything, and she is a first-born. Can I make my Hajj to be for her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Its Recompense would happen to be for her, and there would happen to be for you the like of that, and there would not be a reduction from its Recompense, of anything’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/231)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahimasws (7th Imamasws), said, ‘I asked himasws about the man who performs Hajj, so he makes his Hajj and his Umra, or part of his circumambulation for one of his family members, and he is absent from him in another city. I said, ‘So would that effect a reduction from his Recompense?’ Heasws said: ‘No. It would be for him and for his companion; and for him would be a recompense besides that with what he has linked’. I said, ‘And he is deceased, would that enter upon him?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, to the extent that if he happens to be under Wrath, so it would be Forgiven for him, or if there happens to be a constriction upon him, so it would be Expanded upon him’. I said, ‘So he, in his place, would know that, that deed was performed for his right?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘And even if he was a Nasibi (Hostile one), that would benefit him?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes. It (Punishment) would be Lightened from him’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَحُجُّ فَيَجْعَلُ حَجَّتَهُ وَ عُمْرَتَهُ أَوْ بَعْضَ طَوَافِهِ لِبَعْضِ أَهْلِهِ وَ هُوَ عَنْهُ غَائِبٌ بِبَلَدٍ آخَرَ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَيَنْقُصُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ قَالَ لَا هِيَ لَهُ وَ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَ لَهُ أَجْرٌ سِوَى ذَلِكَ بِمَا وَصَلَ قُلْتُ وَ هُوَ مَيِّتٌ هَلْ يَدْخُلُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ حَتَّى يَكُونُ مَسْخُوطاً عَلَيْهِ فَيُغْفَرُ لَهُ أَوْ يَكُونُ مُضَيَّقاً عَلَيْهِ فَيُوَسَّعُ عَلَيْهِ قُلْتُ فَيَعْلَمُ هُوَ فِي مَكَانِهِ أَنَّ عَمَلَ ذَلِكَ لَحِقَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ نَاصِباً يَنْفَعُهُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ نَعَمْ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُ .

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Haris Bin Al Mugheira who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and I was in Al-Medina after having had returned from Makkah, ‘I intend to perform Hajj on behalf of my daughter’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So make that to be for her, now’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ أَنَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ بَعْدَ مَا رَجَعْتُ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِنِّي أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَحُجَّ عَنِ ابْنَتِي قَالَ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهَا الْآنَ .

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So make that to be for her, now’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hisham Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who participated his father, and his brother, and his relatives in his Hajj. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then, a Hajj would be Written for him similar to their Hajj, and a Recompense would be increased due to what he linked’.

citation.arabic_text: الرَّجُلِ يُشْرِكُ أَبَاهُ وَ أَخَاهُ وَ قَرَابَتَهُ فِي حَجِّهِ فَقَالَ إِذاً يُكْتَبَ لَكَ حَجٌّ مِثْلُ حَجِّهِمْ وَ تُزْدَادَ أَجْراً بِمَا وَصَلْتَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hisham Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who participated his father, and his brother, and his relatives in his Hajj. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Then, a Hajj would be Written for him similar to their Hajj, and a Recompense would be increased due to what he linked’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/232)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Ibn Abu hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who links his father, or one of his relatives, so he circumambulates on his behalf, for him would be his Recompense, complete, and for the one on whose behalf he circumambulated would be similar to his Recompense, and he would be merited with his linking him with another circumambulation’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one performs Hajj, so he makes his Hajj to be on behalf of his relative, linking him with it, his Hajj would be complete, and for the one on whose behalf he performed Hajj would be the like of his Recompense. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Expand for that’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) مَنْ وَصَلَ أَبَاهُ أَوْ ذَا قَرَابَةٍ لَهُ فَطَافَ عَنْهُ كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرُهُ كَامِلًا وَ لِلَّذِي طَافَ عَنْهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ وَ يُفَضَّلُ هُوَ بِصِلَتِهِ إِيَّاهُ بِطَوَافٍ آخَرَ وَ قَالَ مَنْ حَجَّ فَجَعَلَ حَجَّتَهُ عَنْ ذِي قَرَابَتِهِ يَصِلُهُ بِهَا كَانَتْ حَجَّتُهُ كَامِلَةً وَ كَانَ لِلَّذِي حَجَّ عَنْهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَاسِعٌ لِذَلِكَ .

And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one performs Hajj, so he makes his Hajj to be on behalf of his relative, linking him with it, his Hajj would be complete, and for the one on whose behalf he performed Hajj would be the like of his Recompense. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Expand for that’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from one of our companions, from Ali Bin Muhammad Al Ash’as, from Ali Bin Ibrahim Al Hazramy, from his father who said, ‘I returned from Makkah, so I met Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> in the Masjid, and he<sup>asws</sup> was seated in what is between the grave and the Pulpit (of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>). So I said, ‘O son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! When I go out to Makkah, sometimes the man says to me, ‘Circumambulate on my behalf, seven (circuits), and Pray two Cycles’. But, I am too pre-occupied from that, so when I return, I do not know what I should be saying to him’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you go to Makkah, so fulfil your rituals, circumambulate seven (circuits) and Pray two Cycles, then say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! This circumambulation, and these two Cycles (of Prayer) are no behalf of my father and my mother, and on behalf of my wife, and on behalf of my children, and of behalf of my protectors, and on behalf of the entirety of the people of my city, their free ones, and their slaves, and their white ones, and their black ones’. So you would not be saying to the man, ‘I have performed a circumambulation on your behalf, and Prayed two Cycles on your behalf’, except that you would be truthful (in saying that). So when you go to the grave of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, fulfil what is Obligatory upon you. Pray two Cycles, then pause by the head of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, then say, ‘Greetings be upon you<sup>saww</sup>, O Prophet<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, from my father and my mother, and my wife, and my children, and the entirety of the people of my city, their free ones, and they slaves, and their white ones, and their black ones’. So you would not be saying to the man, ‘I conveyed the greetings to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’, except that you would be truthful (in saying that)’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجَعْتُ مِنْ مَكَّةَ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى ( عليه السلام ) فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَ هُوَ قَاعِدٌ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الْقَبْرِ وَ الْمِنْبَرِ فَقُلْتُ يَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ إِنِّي إِذَا خَرَجْتُ إِلَى مَكَّةَ رُبَّمَا قَالَ لِيَ الرَّجُلُ طُفْ عَنِّي أُسْبُوعاً وَ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَأَشْتَغِلُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا رَجَعْتُ لَمْ أَدْرِ مَا أَقُولُ لَهُ قَالَ إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مَكَّةَ فَقَضَيْتَ نُسُكَكَ فَطُفْ أُسْبُوعاً وَ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الطَّوَافَ وَ هَاتَيْنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِي وَ أُمِّي وَ عَنْ زَوْجَتِي وَ عَنْ وُلْدِي وَ عَنْ حَامَّتِي وَ عَنْ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ بَلَدِي حُرِّهِمْ وَ عَبْدِهِمْ وَ أَبْيَضِهِمْ وَ أَسْوَدِهِمْ فَلَا تَشَاءُ أَنْ قُلْتَ لِلرَّجُلِ إِنِّي قَدْ طُفْتُ عَنْكَ وَ صَلَّيْتُ عَنْكَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ إِلَّا كُنْتَ صَادِقاً فَإِذَا أَتَيْتَ قَبْرَ النَّبِيِّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فَقَضَيْتَ مَا يَجِبُ عَلَيْكَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قِفْ عِنْدَ رَأْسِ النَّبِيِّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) ثُمَّ قُلْ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَبِي وَ أُمِّي وَ زَوْجَتِي وَ وُلْدِي وَ جَمِيعِ حَامَّتِي وَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ بَلَدِي حُرِّهِمْ وَ عَبْدِهِمْ وَ أَبْيَضِهِمْ وَ أَسْوَدِهِمْ فَلَا تَشَاءُ أَنْ تَقُولَ لِلرَّجُلِ إِنِّي أَقْرَأْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) عَنْكَ السَّلَامَ إِلَّا كُنْتَ صَادِقاً .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail who said, ‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘How many can I participate in my Hajj?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘As many as you like to’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) كَمْ أُشْرِكُ فِي حَجَّتِي قَالَ كَمْ شِئْتَ .

text: Ahmad Bin Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Abu Imran Al Armany, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you were to participate a thousand in your Hajj, there would be a Hajj for each one, from without there being a reduction of anything in your Hajj’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) لَوْ أَشْرَكْتَ أَلْفاً فِي حَجَّتِكَ لَكَانَ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ حَجَّةٌ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تَنْقُصَ حَجَّتُكَ شَيْئاً .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Abu Imran Al Armany, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you were to participate a thousand in your Hajj, there would be a Hajj for each one, from without there being a reduction of anything in your Hajj’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Hajj is in known months – Shawwal, and Zil-Qadah, and Zil Hijja. So the one who intends the Hajj should let his hair grow when he looks at the crescent of Zilqadah; and the one who intends the Umra should let his hair grow for a month’.

citation.arabic_text: الْحَجُّ أَشْهُرٌ مَعْلُومَاتٌ شَوَّالٌ وَ ذُو الْقَعْدَةِ وَ ذُو الْحِجَّةِ فَمَنْ أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ وَفَّرَ شَعْرَهُ إِذَا نَظَرَ إِلَى هِلَالِ ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ وَ مَنْ أَرَادَ الْعُمْرَةَ وَفَّرَ شَعْرَهُ شَهْراً .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The Hajj is in known months – Shawwal, and Zil-Qadah, and Zil Hijja.
