citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/302)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked himasws about the woman for whom a shade is established and she is in Ihraam. Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘So the man upon whom a shade is struck and he is in Ihraam?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, when he was with a headache, and he would have to give in charity with one Mudd (750 gms approximately of wheat etc.) for each day’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ يُضْرَبُ عَلَيْهَا الظِّلَالُ وَ هِيَ مُحْرِمَةٌ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ فَالرَّجُلُ يُضْرَبُ عَلَيْهِ الظِّلَالُ وَ هُوَ مُحْرِمٌ قَالَ نَعَمْ إِذَا كَانَتْ بِهِ شَقِيقَةٌ وَ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِمُدٍّ لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked himasws about the woman for whom a shade is established and she is in Ihraam. Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘So the man upon whom a shade is struck and he is in Ihraam?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, when he was with a headache, and he would have to give in charity with one Mudd (750 gms approximately of wheat etc.) for each day’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/302)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie who said, ‘I wrote to Al-Rezaasws, ‘Is it allowed for the one in Ihraam if he walks under a shade of the carriage?’ So heasws said: ‘Yes’. He (the narrator) said, ‘And a man asked himasws about the shade for the one in Ihraam, from the harm of rain, or sun, and I was listening. So heasws ordered him that he should expiate with a sheep, and slaughter it at Mina’.

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى الرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) هَلْ يَجُوزُ لِلْمُحْرِمِ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ تَحْتَ ظِلِّ الْمَحْمِلِ فَكَتَبَ نَعَمْ قَالَ وَ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَنِ الظِّلَالِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ مِنْ أَذَى مَطَرٍ أَوْ شَمْسٍ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَفْدِيَ شَاةً وَ يَذْبَحَهَا بِمِنًى .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Bazie who said, ‘I wrote to Al-Rezaasws, ‘Is it allowed for the one in Ihraam if he walks under a shade of the carriage?’ So heasws said: ‘Yes’. He (the narrator) said, ‘And a man asked himasws about the shade for the one in Ihraam, from the harm of rain, or sun, and I was listening. So heasws ordered him that he should expiate with a sheep, and slaughter it at Mina’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/303)

text: Ahmad, from Ali Bin Ahmad Bin Asheym, from Musa Bin Umar, from Muhammad Bin Mansour, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassanasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the shade for the one in Ihraam. Heasws said: ‘He should not shade except from a reason of illness’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الظِّلَالِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ قَالَ لَا يُظَلِّلْ إِلَّا مِنْ عِلَّةِ مَرَضٍ .
citation.translation: Ahmad, from Ali Bin Ahmad Bin Asheym, from Musa Bin Umar, from Muhammad Bin Mansour, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassanasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the shade for the one in Ihraam. Heasws said: ‘He should not shade except from a reason of illness’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/304)

text: Ahmad, from Usman Bin Isa Al Kilaby who said, ‘I said to Abu Al-Hassanasws the 1st that Ali Bin Shihaab complained about his headache and the intense cold, and he intends to wear Ihraam. So heasws said: ‘If it was as you are claiming, so let him shade (himself). And as for you, so brightness is for the Oneazwj Whom you are wearing Ihraam for’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ شِهَابٍ يَشْكُو رَأْسَهُ وَ الْبَرْدُ شَدِيدٌ وَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَ كَمَا زَعَمَ فَلْيُظَلِّلْ وَ أَمَّا أَنْتَ فَاضْحَ لِمَنْ أَحْرَمْتَ لَهُ .
citation.translation: Ahmad, from Usman Bin Isa Al Kilaby who said, ‘I said to Abu Al-Hassanasws the 1st that Ali Bin Shihaab complained about his headache and the intense cold, and he intends to wear Ihraam. So heasws said: ‘If it was as you are claiming, so let him shade (himself). And as for you, so brightness is for the Oneazwj Whom you are wearing Ihraam for’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/304)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ismail Bin Abdul Khaliq who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Can the one in Ihraam veil himself from the sun?’ So heasws said: ‘No, except he happens to be an old man’. Or heasws said: ‘(When he is) with an illness’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) هَلْ يَسْتَتِرُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ لَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ شَيْخاً كَبِيراً أَوْ قَالَ ذَا عِلَّةٍ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ismail Bin Abdul Khaliq who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Can the one in Ihraam veil himself from the sun?’ So heasws said: ‘No, except he happens to be an old man’. Or heasws said: ‘(When he is) with an illness’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/304)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibrahim Bin Abu Mahmud who said, ‘I said to Al-Rezaasws, ‘The one in Ihraam shades upon his carriage, and he expiates when there was the sun and the rain, being harmed by it’. Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘How much is the expiation?’ Heasws said: ‘A sheep’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا ( عليه السلام ) الْمُحْرِمُ يُظَلِّلُ عَلَى مَحْمِلِهِ وَ يَفْتَدِي إِذَا كَانَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَ الْمَطَرُ يُضِرَّانِ بِهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ كَمِ الْفِدَاءُ قَالَ شَاةٌ .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibrahim Bin Abu Mahmud who said, ‘I said to Al-Rezaasws, ‘The one in Ihraam shades upon his carriage, and he expiates when there was the sun and the rain, being harmed by it’. Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said, ‘How much is the expiation?’ Heasws said: ‘A sheep’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/304)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Kahily, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘There is no problem with the tent upon the women and the children, and they are in Ihraam’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا بَأْسَ بِالْقُبَّةِ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ وَ الصِّبْيَانِ وَ هُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Kahily, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘There is no problem with the tent upon the women and the children, and they are in Ihraam’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/305)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al Halby, from Al Moalla Bin Khunays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot veil himself from the sun by clothes, and there is no problem if he were to veil himself with part of himself (like a hand etc.) the other parts (like face etc.)’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا يَسْتَتِرُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الشَّمْسِ بِثَوْبٍ وَ لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَسْتَتِرَ بَعْضَهُ بِبَعْضٍ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al Halby, from Al Moalla Bin Khunays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot veil himself from the sun by clothes, and there is no problem if he were to veil himself with part of himself (like a hand etc.) the other parts (like face etc.)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مختلف فيه - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/305)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Bakr Bin Salih who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Ja’farasws that my paternal aunt is with me and she is my colleague, and the heat is intense upon her when she wears Ihraam. So, what is yourasws view for me if I were to shade upon myself and upon her?’ So heasws wrote: ‘Shade upon her alone’.

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَنَّ عَمَّتِي مَعِي وَ هِيَ زَمِيلَتِي وَ الْحَرُّ تَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهَا إِذَا أَحْرَمَتْ فَتَرَى لِي أَنْ أُظَلِّلَ عَلَيَّ وَ عَلَيْهَا فَكَتَبَ ( عليه السلام ) ظَلِّلْ عَلَيْهَا وَحْدَهَا .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Bakr Bin Salih who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Ja’farasws that my paternal aunt is with me and she is my colleague, and the heat is intense upon her when she wears Ihraam. So, what is yourasws view for me if I were to shade upon myself and upon her?’ So heasws wrote: ‘Shade upon her alone’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/305)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban, from Zurara who said, ‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam, can he cover himself?’ Heasws said: ‘As for, from the heat and the cold, so no’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمُحْرِمِ أَ يَتَغَطَّى قَالَ أَمَّا مِنَ الْحَرِّ وَ الْبَرْدِ فَلَا .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban, from Zurara who said, ‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam, can he cover himself?’ Heasws said: ‘As for, from the heat and the cold, so no’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/305)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Ali Bin Rashid who said, ‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam shading himself during his Umra. Heasws said: ‘Blood (slaughter of an animal) is Obligated upon him’. Heasws said: ‘And if he goes out to Makka and shades, so it Obligates the blood (slaughter of an animal) upon him as well for his Umra, and blood (slaughter of an animal) for his Hajj’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ مُحْرِمٍ ظَلَّلَ فِي عُمْرَتِهِ قَالَ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ دَمٌ قَالَ وَ إِنْ خَرَجَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ وَ ظَلَّلَ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ أَيْضاً دَمٌ لِعُمْرَتِهِ وَ دَمٌ لِحَجَّتِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Ali Bin Rashid who said, ‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam shading himself during his Umra. Heasws said: ‘Blood (slaughter of an animal) is Obligated upon him’. Heasws said: ‘And if he goes out to Makka and shades, so it Obligates the blood (slaughter of an animal) upon him as well for his Umra, and blood (slaughter of an animal) for his Hajj’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/306)

text: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu najran, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl who said, ‘We were in a hallway of Yahya Bin Khalid in Makkah, and over there was Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws, and Abu Yusuf. So Abu Yusufasws stood up to himasws and squatted in front of himasws, and he said, ‘O Abu Al Hassanasws! May I be sacrificed for youasws! The one in Ihraam can shade?’ Heasws said: ‘No’. He said, ‘So can he shade by the wall, and the carriage, and enter the house, and the tent?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’. So Abu Yusuf laughed in a scoffing manner. So Abu Al-Hassanasws said to him: ‘O Abu Yusuf! The Religion is not with the analogy like your analogies, and the analogies of your companions. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Commanded in Hisazwj Book with the divorce, and corroborated regarding it with two witnesses, and Heazwj was not Pleased with these two unless they were both just, and Commanded in Hisazwj Book with the marriage, and Left it out without (necessitating) witnesses. But you are coming with two witnesses in what Allahazwj has Voided, and you are voiding the two witnesses in what Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Corroborated, and, you are allowing a divorce of the insane one, and the intoxicated one? Rasool-Allahsaww performed Hajj, so hesaww wore Ihraam and did no shade himselfsaww, and entered the house, and the tent, and shaded with the carriage, and the wall. Weasws are doing just as Rasool-Allahsaww did’. So he was silent’.

citation.arabic_text: كُنَّا فِي دِهْلِيزِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَالِدٍ بِمَكَّةَ وَ كَانَ هُنَاكَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى ( عليه السلام ) وَ أَبُو يُوسُفَ فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ أَبُو يُوسُفَ وَ تَرَبَّعَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الْحَسَنِ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ الْمُحْرِمُ يُظَلِّلُ قَالَ لَا قَالَ فَيَسْتَظِلُّ بِالْجِدَارِ وَ الْمَحْمِلِ وَ يَدْخُلُ الْبَيْتَ وَ الْخِبَاءَ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَضَحِكَ أَبُو يُوسُفَ شِبْهَ الْمُسْتَهْزِئِ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) يَا أَبَا يُوسُفَ إِنَّ الدِّينَ لَيْسَ بِالْقِيَاسِ كَقِيَاسِكَ وَ قِيَاسِ أَصْحَابِكَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَمَرَ فِي كِتَابِهِ بِالطَّلَاقِ وَ أَكَّدَ فِيهِ بِشَاهِدَيْنِ وَ لَمْ يَرْضَ بِهِمَا إِلَّا عَدْلَيْنِ وَ أَمَرَ فِي كِتَابِهِ بِالتَّزْوِيجِ وَ أَهْمَلَهُ بِلَا شُهُودٍ فَأَتَيْتُمْ بِشَاهِدَيْنِ فِيمَا أَبْطَلَ اللَّهُ وَ أَبْطَلْتُمْ شَاهِدَيْنِ فِيمَا أَكَّدَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ أَجَزْتُمْ طَلَاقَ الْمَجْنُونِ وَ السَّكْرَانِ حَجَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فَأَحْرَمَ وَ لَمْ يُظَلِّلْ وَ دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ وَ الْخِبَاءَ وَ اسْتَظَلَّ بِالْمَحْمِلِ وَ الْجِدَارِ فَعَلْنَا كَمَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) فَسَكَتَ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from the one who informed him, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot immerse himself into the water’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا يَرْتَمِسُ الْمُحْرِمُ فِي الْمَاءِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from the one who informed him, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot immerse himself into the water’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/307)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Neither the one in Ihraam nor the Fasting one can immerse himself into the water’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا يَرْتَمِسُ الْمُحْرِمُ فِي الْمَاءِ وَ لَا الصَّائِمُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Neither the one in Ihraam nor the Fasting one can immerse himself into the water’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/307)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan and Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws who said, ‘You can neither touch anything from the perfumes, nor from the oils while being in your Ihraam; and fear the perfume in your meals, restrain your nose from the aromas of perfumes, and do not hold it from the fetid smell, for it is not befitting for the one in Ihraam that he indulges in pleasures with aromas of perfumes’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا تَمَسَّ شَيْئاً مِنَ الطِّيبِ وَ لَا مِنَ الدُّهْنِ فِي إِحْرَامِكَ وَ اتَّقِ الطِّيبَ فِي طَعَامِكَ وَ أَمْسِكْ عَلَى أَنْفِكَ مِنَ الرَّائِحَةِ الطَّيِّبَةِ وَ لَا تُمْسِكْ عَنْهُ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُنْتِنَةِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَنْبَغِي لِلْمُحْرِمِ أَنْ يَتَلَذَّذَ بِرِيحٍ طَيِّبَةٍ.
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan and Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws who said, ‘You can neither touch anything from the perfumes, nor from the oils while being in your Ihraam; and fear the perfume in your meals, restrain your nose from the aromas of perfumes, and do not hold it from the fetid smell, for it is not befitting for the one in Ihraam that he indulges in pleasures with aromas of perfumes’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/307)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from the one who informed him, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot touch anything from the perfumes, nor the aromas, nor derive pleasures by it, nor with an aromatic wind. So the one who indulges with something from that, so let him give in charity by a measurement of what he did in accordance of his capacity’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا يَمَسَّ الْمُحْرِمُ شَيْئاً مِنَ الطِّيبِ وَ لَا الرَّيْحَانِ وَ لَا يَتَلَذَّذْ بِهِ وَ لَا بِرِيحٍ طَيِّبَةٍ فَمَنِ ابْتُلِيَ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِقَدْرِ مَا صَنَعَ قَدْرَ سَعَتِهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from the one who informed him, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot touch anything from the perfumes, nor the aromas, nor derive pleasures by it, nor with an aromatic wind. So the one who indulges with something from that, so let him give in charity by a measurement of what he did in accordance of his capacity’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/308)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban Bin Usman, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who eats saffron deliberately, or some food in which is aroma, so upon him is blood (slaughter of an animal). So if it was due to forgetfulness, so there is nothing upon him, and he should seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.

citation.arabic_text: مَنْ أَكَلَ زَعْفَرَاناً مُتَعَمِّداً أَوْ طَعَاماً فِيهِ طِيبٌ فَعَلَيْهِ دَمٌ فَإِنْ كَانَ نَاسِياً فَلَا شَيْ‏ءَ عَلَيْهِ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban Bin Usman, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The one who eats saffron deliberately, or some food in which is aroma, so upon him is blood (slaughter of an animal). So if it was due to forgetfulness, so there is nothing upon him, and he should seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/309)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam should withhold his nose from the aromas of perfumes, and he should not withhold his nose from the fetid smells’.

citation.arabic_text: الْمُحْرِمُ يُمْسِكُ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الطَّيِّبَةِ وَ لَا يُمْسِكُ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُنْتِنَةِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam should withhold his nose from the aromas of perfumes, and he should not withhold his nose from the fetid smells’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/310)

text: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, similar to it, (It has been narrated) and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with the aroma of the perfume in what is between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa from the aromas of the perfume sellers, and he does not have to withhold his nose’.

citation.arabic_text: وَ قَالَ لَا بَأْسَ بِالرِّيحِ الطَّيِّبَةِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَ الْمَرْوَةِ مِنْ رِيحِ الْعَطَّارِينَ وَ لَا يُمْسِكْ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ .
citation.translation: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam, similar to it, (It has been narrated) and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with the aroma of the perfume in what is between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa from the aromas of the perfume sellers, and he does not have to withhold his nose’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail who said, ‘I saw Abu Al-Hassanasws uncover a perfume in front of him in order to look at it, and heasws was in Ihraam, so heasws withheld hisasws nose by hisasws cloth, from its aroma’.

citation.arabic_text: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ( عليه السلام ) كُشِفَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ طِيبٌ لِيَنْظُرَ إِلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَأَمْسَكَ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ بِثَوْبِهِ مِنْ رِيحِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail who said, ‘I saw Abu Al-Hassanasws uncover a perfume in front of him in order to look at it, and heasws was in Ihraam, so heasws withheld hisasws nose by hisasws cloth, from its aroma’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/310)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban Bin Usman, from Al Hassan Bin Ziyad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I said to himasws, ‘The potash wherein is the perfume, Can I wash my hands with it and I am in Ihraam?’ Heasws said: ‘When you intend to wear the Ihraam, so look into your provisions and isolate that which you are not going to be needy to’. And heasws said: ‘You should give in charity with something as an expiration of the potash which you washed your hands with’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لَهُ الْأُشْنَانُ فِيهِ الطِّيبُ أَغْسِلُ بِهِ يَدَيَّ وَ أَنَا مُحْرِمٌ قَالَ إِذَا أَرَدْتُمُ الْإِحْرَامَ فَانْظُرُوا مَزَاوِدَكُمْ فَاعْزِلُوا الَّذِي لَا تَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَ قَالَ تَصَدَّقْ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ كَفَّارَةً لِلْأُشْنَانِ الَّذِي غَسَلْتَ بِهِ يَدَكَ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban Bin Usman, from Al Hassan Bin Ziyad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I said to himasws, ‘The potash wherein is the perfume, Can I wash my hands with it and I am in Ihraam?’ Heasws said: ‘When you intend to wear the Ihraam, so look into your provisions and isolate that which you are not going to be needy to’. And heasws said: ‘You should give in charity with something as an expiration of the potash which you washed your hands with’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/310)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the one in Ihraam whose clothes are hit by the perfume. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem with if he was to wash by his own hands’.

citation.arabic_text: الْمُحْرِمِ يُصِيبُ ثَوْبَهُ الطِّيبُ قَالَ لَا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يَغْسِلَهُ بِيَدِ نَفْسِهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the one in Ihraam whose clothes are hit by the perfume. Heasws said: ‘There is no problem with if he was to wash by his own hands’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/310)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdul Kareem, from Al Hassan Bin Haroun who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘I ate Khabeys (a porridge) until I was satiated, and I am in Ihraam’. So heasws said: ‘When you are free from performing your rituals and intend to exit from Makkah, so buy some dates with one Dirham and give in charity with it, so it would become an expiation for that, and for what might have entered in your Ihraam from what you do not know’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنِّي أَكَلْتُ خَبِيصاً حَتَّى شَبِعْتُ وَ أَنَا مُحْرِمٌ فَقَالَ إِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنْ مَنَاسِكِكَ وَ أَرَدْتَ الْخُرُوجَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ فَابْتَعْ بِدِرْهَمٍ تَمْراً فَتَصَدَّقْ بِهِ فَيَكُونَ كَفَّارَةً لِذَلِكَ وَ لِمَا دَخَلَ فِي إِحْرَامِكَ مِمَّا لَا تَعْلَمُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abdul Kareem, from Al Hassan Bin Haroun who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘I ate Khabeys (a porridge) until I was satiated, and I am in Ihraam’. So heasws said: ‘When you are free from performing your rituals and intend to exit from Makkah, so buy some dates with one Dirham and give in charity with it, so it would become an expiation for that, and for what might have entered in your Ihraam from what you do not know’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Hanaan Bin Sudeyr, from his father who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘What are youasws saying regarding the salt wherein is saffron, for the one in Ihraam?’ Heasws said: ‘It is not befitting for the one in Ihraam that he should be eating something wherein is saffron, nor anything from the perfumes’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) مَا تَقُولُ فِي الْمِلْحِ فِيهِ زَعْفَرَانٌ لِلْمُحْرِمِ قَالَ لَا يَنْبَغِي لِلْمُحْرِمِ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ شَيْئاً فِيهِ زَعْفَرَانٌ وَ لَا شَيْئاً مِنَ الطِّيبِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Hanaan Bin Sudeyr, from his father who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘What are youasws saying regarding the salt wherein is saffron, for the one in Ihraam?’ Heasws said: ‘It is not befitting for the one in Ihraam that he should be eating something wherein is saffron, nor anything from the perfumes’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن أو موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/311)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Bin Imran Al Halby, from Al Moalla Abu Usman, from Moalla Bin Khunays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘It is dislike that the one in Ihraam should sleep upon a yellow bed or upon a yellow bed-spread’.

citation.arabic_text: كُرِهَ أَنْ يَنَامَ الْمُحْرِمُ عَلَى فِرَاشٍ أَصْفَرَ أَوْ عَلَى مِرْفَقَةٍ صَفْرَاءَ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Bin Imran Al Halby, from Al Moalla Abu Usman, from Moalla Bin Khunays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘It is dislike that the one in Ihraam should sleep upon a yellow bed or upon a yellow bed-spread’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مختلف فيه - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/311)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Do not smell the aromas and you are in Ihraam, nor anything wherein is saffron, nor eat a meal with saffron in it’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا تَمَسَّ رَيْحَاناً وَ أَنْتَ مُحْرِمٌ وَ لَا شَيْئاً فِيهِ زَعْفَرَانٌ وَ لَا تَطْعَمْ طَعَاماً فِيهِ زَعْفَرَانٌ .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Do not smell the aromas and you are in Ihraam, nor anything wherein is saffron, nor eat a meal with saffron in it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/311)

text: Saffron, from Abu Al Magra who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the one in Ihraam washing his hand with the potash. Heasws said: ‘Myasws fatherasws used to wash hisasws hand with the white potash’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الْمُحْرِمِ يَغْسِلُ يَدَهُ بِالْأُشْنَانِ قَالَ كَانَ أَبِي يَغْسِلُ يَدَهُ بِالْحُرُضِ الْأَبْيَضِ .
citation.translation: Saffron, from Abu Al Magra who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the one in Ihraam washing his hand with the potash. Heasws said: ‘Myasws fatherasws used to wash hisasws hand with the white potash’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/312)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘There is no problem with it if you were to smell the lemon-grass, and the Achilles (plant), and the lavender; and wormwood, and whatever resembles it, while you are in Ihraam’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تَشَمَّ الْإِذْخِرَ وَ الْقَيْصُومَ وَ الْخُزَامَى وَ الشِّيحَ وَ أَشْبَاهَهُ وَ أَنْتَ مُحْرِمٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘There is no problem with it if you were to smell the lemon-grass, and the Achilles (plant), and the lavender; and wormwood, and whatever resembles it, while you are in Ihraam’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/312)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Hilal, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam touching the perfume and he is asleep. Heasws said: ‘He should wash it, and there is nothing upon him (to expiate)’. And about the one in Ihraam being massaged by the one not in Ihraam, with the aromatic oil, and the one in Ihraam does not know what is upon him. Heasws said: ‘He should wash it as well, and let him be cautious’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمُحْرِمِ يَمَسُّ الطِّيبَ وَ هُوَ نَائِمٌ لَا يَعْلَمُ قَالَ يَغْسِلُهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْ‏ءٌ وَ عَنِ الْمُحْرِمِ يَدْهُنُهُ الْحَلَالُ بِالدُّهْنِ الطَّيِّبِ وَ الْمُحْرِمُ لَا يَعْلَمُ مَا عَلَيْهِ قَالَ يَغْسِلُهُ أَيْضاً وَ لْيَحْذَرْ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Hilal, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam touching the perfume and he is asleep. Heasws said: ‘He should wash it, and there is nothing upon him (to expiate)’. And about the one in Ihraam being massaged by the one not in Ihraam, with the aromatic oil, and the one in Ihraam does not know what is upon him. Heasws said: ‘He should wash it as well, and let him be cautious’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/312)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Bin Musa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam eating the citron. Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said to himasws, ‘Its smell is aromatic’. Heasws said: ‘The citron is food. It is not from the perfumes’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمُحْرِمِ يَأْكُلُ الْأُتْرُجَّ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ لَهُ رَائِحَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ قَالَ الْأُتْرُجُّ طَعَامٌ لَيْسَ هُوَ مِنَ الطِّيبِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Bin Musa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam eating the citron. Heasws said: ‘Yes’. I said to himasws, ‘Its smell is aromatic’. Heasws said: ‘The citron is food. It is not from the perfumes’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح موقوف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/312)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Henna. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If the one in Ihraaam, let him touch it and heal his camel with it, and it is not a perfume, and there is no problem with it’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْحِنَّاءِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْمُحْرِمَ لَيَمَسُّهُ وَ يُدَاوِي بِهِ بَعِيرَهُ وَ مَا هُوَ بِطِيبٍ وَ مَا بِهِ بَأْسٌ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Henna. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If the one in Ihraaam, let him touch it and heal his camel with it, and it is not a perfume, and there is no problem with it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/313)

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Al Abbas Bin aamir, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘I made my clothes to be my Ihraam along with clothes which had been incensed with. So I found from its aroma’. Heasws said: ‘Spread it out in the wind until its aroma goes away’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) إِنِّي جَعَلْتُ ثَوْبَيْ إِحْرَامِي مَعَ أَثْوَابٍ قَدْ جُمِّرَتْ فَأَجِدُ مِنْ رِيحِهَا قَالَ فَانْشُرْهَا فِي الرِّيحِ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ رِيحُهَا .
citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Al Abbas Bin aamir, from Hammad Bin Usman who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘I made my clothes to be my Ihraam along with clothes which had been incensed with. So I found from its aroma’. Heasws said: ‘Spread it out in the wind until its aroma goes away’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/313)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘You should not look into the mirror and you are in Ihraam, because it is from the adornments; and the female in Ihraam should not apply Kohl with the blackness if the blackness is an adornment’.

citation.arabic_text: لَا تَنْظُرْ فِي الْمِرْآةِ وَ أَنْتَ مُحْرِمٌ لِأَنَّهُ مِنَ الزِّينَةِ وَ لَا تَكْتَحِلِ الْمَرْأَةُ الْمُحْرِمَةُ بِالسَّوَادِ إِنَّ السَّوَادَ زِينَةٌ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘You should not look into the mirror and you are in Ihraam, because it is from the adornments; and the female in Ihraam should not apply Kohl with the blackness if the blackness is an adornment’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/314)

text: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot look into the mirror in order to adorn. So if he looks, he should exclaim Talbiyya’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) لَا يَنْظُرِ الْمُحْرِمُ فِي الْمِرْآةِ لِزِينَةٍ فَإِنْ نَظَرَ فَلْيُلَبِّ .
citation.translation: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said, ‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot look into the mirror in order to adorn. So if he looks, he should exclaim Talbiyya’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/314)

text: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Kohl for the one in Ihraam. Heasws said: ‘As for (applying) with the blackness, so no. But, (yes) with the Al-Sabr and Al-Huzuz (eye powders for treatment)’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْكُحْلِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ قَالَ أَمَّا بِالسَّوَادِ فَلَا وَ لَكِنْ بِالصَّبِرِ وَ الْحُضُضِ .
citation.translation: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Kohl for the one in Ihraam. Heasws said: ‘As for (applying) with the blackness, so no. But, (yes) with the Al-Sabr and Al-Huzuz (eye powders for treatment)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (17/315)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hasan Bin Ali, from Aban, from the one who informed him, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When the one in Ihraam complains of his eyes, so let him apply Kohl wherein is neither musk nor perfume’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا اشْتَكَى الْمُحْرِمُ عَيْنَيْهِ فَلْيَكْتَحِلْ بِكُحْلٍ لَيْسَ فِيهِ مِسْكٌ وَ لَا طِيبٌ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hasan Bin Ali, from Aban, from the one who informed him, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When the one in Ihraam complains of his eyes, so let him apply Kohl wherein is neither musk nor perfume’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/315)

text: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot apply Kohl except for pain’. And heasws said: ‘There is no problem with if you apply Kohl and you are in Ihraam, with what does not happen to have perfume in it or its aroma is not found. But, as for adornment, so no’.

citation.arabic_text: الْمُحْرِمُ لَا يَكْتَحِلْ إِلَّا مِنْ وَجَعٍ وَ قَالَ لَا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تَكْتَحِلَ وَ أَنْتَ مُحْرِمٌ بِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ طِيبٌ يُوجَدُ رِيحُهُ فَأَمَّا لِلزِّينَةِ فَلَا .
citation.translation: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one in Ihraam cannot apply Kohl except for pain’. And heasws said: ‘There is no problem with if you apply Kohl and you are in Ihraam, with what does not happen to have perfume in it or its aroma is not found. But, as for adornment, so no’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/315)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When the one in Ihraam complains, so let him be treated with that what he eats, while he is in Ihraam’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا اشْتَكَى الْمُحْرِمُ فَلْيَتَدَاوَ بِمَا يَأْكُلُ وَ هُوَ مُحْرِمٌ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When the one in Ihraam complains, so let him be treated with that what he eats, while he is in Ihraam’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/316)

text: Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from the one who informed him, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww passed by Ka’ab Bin Ujra and lice was scattering from his head, and he was in Ihraam. So hesaww said to him: ‘Your vermins are harming you?’ So he said, ‘Yes’. So this Verse was Revealed [2:196] but whoever among you is sick or has an ailment of the head, he (should effect) a compensation by Fasting or alms or sacrificing. So Rasool-Allahsaww ordered him that he should shave off his head and make the Fasting to be for three days, and to give charity upon six poor ones, for each poor one being two Mudds (750 gms x 2), and sacrifice a sheep’. Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘And everything is from the Quran, or its doer is with the choice, he can choose whatever he so desires to; and everything from the Quran, ‘so the one who cannot find such and such, so upon him is such and such’, so he would have preference with the choice’.

citation.arabic_text: مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) عَلَى كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ وَ الْقَمْلُ يَتَنَاثَرُ مِنْ رَأْسِهِ وَ هُوَ مُحْرِمٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَ تُؤْذِيكَ هَوَامُّكَ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ فَأُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ فَمَنْ كانَ مِنْكُمْ مَرِيضاً أَوْ بِهِ أَذىً مِنْ رَأْسِهِ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَنْ يَحْلِقَ وَ جَعَلَ الصِّيَامَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ وَ الصَّدَقَةَ عَلَى سِتَّةِ مَسَاكِينَ لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ مُدَّيْنِ وَ النُّسُكَ شَاةً قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ أَوْ فَصَاحِبُهُ بِالْخِيَارِ يَخْتَارُ مَا شَاءَ وَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ كَذَا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذَا فَالْأُولَى الْخِيَارُ .
citation.translation: Ali, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from the one who informed him, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww passed by Ka’ab Bin Ujra and lice was scattering from his head, and he was in Ihraam. So hesaww said to him: ‘Your vermins are harming you?’ So he said, ‘Yes’. So this Verse was Revealed [2:196] but whoever among you is sick or has an ailment of the head, he (should effect) a compensation by Fasting or alms or sacrificing. So Rasool-Allahsaww ordered him that he should shave off his head and make the Fasting to be for three days, and to give charity upon six poor ones, for each poor one being two Mudds (750 gms x 2), and sacrifice a sheep’. Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘And everything is from the Quran, or its doer is with the choice, he can choose whatever he so desires to; and everything from the Quran, ‘so the one who cannot find such and such, so upon him is such and such’, so he would have preference with the choice’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل معتبر - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (7/316)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abdullah Bin Yahya Al Kahily, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘A man of impaired vision asked himasws, and I was present, so he said, ‘Can I apply Kohl when I wear Ihraam?’ Heasws said: ‘No, and why would you apply Kohl?’ He said, ‘I am of impaired vision. So when I apply Kohl, it benefits me, and when I do not apply Kohl, it harms me’. Heasws said: ‘So apply Kohl’. He said, ‘Supposing if I was to make something else to be along with the Kohl?’ Heasws said: ‘What would it be?’ He said, ‘I take to rags and I fold them, so I make one rag to be upon each eye, and I tie these upon with a strip to the back of my head. So when I do so, that benefits me, and when I neglect it, it harms me’. Heasws said: ‘So do it’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ ضَرِيرُ الْبَصَرِ وَ أَنَا حَاضِرٌ فَقَالَ أَكْتَحِلُ إِذَا أَحْرَمْتُ قَالَ لَا وَ لِمَ تَكْتَحِلُ قَالَ إِنِّي ضَرِيرُ الْبَصَرِ فَإِذَا أَنَا اكْتَحَلْتُ نَفَعَنِي وَ إِذَا لَمْ أَكْتَحِلْ ضَرَّنِي قَالَ فَاكْتَحِلْ قَالَ فَإِنِّي أَجْعَلُ مَعَ الْكُحْلِ غَيْرَهُ قَالَ مَا هُوَ قَالَ آخُذُ خِرْقَتَيْنِ فَأُرَبِّعُهُمَا فَأَجْعَلُ عَلَى كُلِّ عَيْنٍ خِرْقَةً وَ أُعَصِّبُهُمَا بِعِصَابَةٍ إِلَى قَفَايَ فَإِذَا فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ نَفَعَنِي وَ إِذَا تَرَكْتُهُ ضَرَّنِي قَالَ فَاصْنَعْهُ . قَالَ فَإِنِّي أَجْعَلُ مَعَ الْكُحْلِ غَيْرَهُ قَالَ مَا هُوَ قَالَ آخُذُ خِرْقَتَيْنِ فَأُرَبِّعُهُمَا فَأَجْعَلُ عَلَى كُلِّ عَيْنٍ خِرْقَةً وَ أُعَصِّبُهُمَا بِعِصَابَةٍ إِلَى قَفَايَ فَإِذَا فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ نَفَعَنِي وَ إِذَا تَرَكْتُهُ ضَرَّنِي قَالَ فَاصْنَعْهُ .
